notes.title: Patch 0.7.34 Notes: 2019 Springfest, Bug Fixes and More
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/39527efb2a5d7072d793b59f36be6deeef5e1b0a.jpg[/img]

Greeting Commanders, 

The server maintenance will take about 3 hours and be held on: 
00:50 January 17 PDT
07:50 January 17 GMT
15:50 January 17 GMT+8

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]
[h1]1. 2019 Springfest will be live![/h1]
1) Event Period
After patch – 08:00 February 14, 2019 GMT
2)	Firecrackers
•	During the Springfest, players have a great chance to get firecrackers in Quick Play or Ranked modes.
•	Complete daily quests to earn a large amount of firecrackers.
•	Players will not be rewarded with firecrackers in Versus A.I. mode or when they pass the Rested period.
3)	Springfest Store
•	In the Springfest Store, players can exchange exclusive avatars, unit skin Pangolin Colonel, unit skin God of wind and runes with firecrackers.
•	The Store will be closed 1 week after the Springfest ends.

[h1]2. Springfest Challenge[/h1]
1) Event Period
After patch – 21:00 February 14, 2019 GMT
2) Rules and Rewards
•	Acquire a certain amount of firecrackers to unlock lucky bags, from which players can get a large amount of rune dust, firecrackers or the unit skin Dantalion for the Illusionist.

[h1]3. Lucky Envelope[/h1]
1) Event Period
21:00 February 01 GMT – 21:00 February 14, 2019 GMT
2) Login Gift
•	During the event, go to “SPRINGFEST” > “Lucky Envelope” every day to claim coin boosts, runes, firecrackers or, the unit skin Vampire Bat for the Shadow Bat.
•	If players forget to claim gift the day/days before, they can get them with gems or firecrackers in chronological order.

[h1]4. Other Events[/h1]
1) Coin Rush
•	Event Period: 21:00 January 29 GMT – 21:00 February 01 GMT
           21:00 February 08 GMT – 21:00 February 11 GMT
•	During the event, players will gain 100% coins from battles. Once the event ends, coin cap will be reset.
•	Bonus coins granted by base skin, coins boosts and/or others will not be affected.

2) Battle for More
•	Event Period: 21:00 January 23 GMT – 21:00 January 28 GMT
           21:00 February 03 GMT – 21:00 February 08 GMT
•	During the event, players can always gain double XP and a chest after a battle.

3)	No Drop in Stars
•	Event Period: After patch – 21:00 January 19 GMT
           21:00 February 03 GMT – 21:00 February 11 GMT
•	During the event, players will not lose stars for 2 losses in Ranked every day.
•	The timer will be reset at 21:00 GMT every day.

[h1]5. 2019 Springfest Sale[/h1]
1) 25% Off on Supply Drops
•	Event Period: 21:00 January 30 GMT – 21:00 February 08 GMT

2) 50% Off on Skill Skins
•	Event Period: 21:00 January 30 GMT – 21:00 February 08 GMT

3) Eternium Ingots for Returns
•	Event Period: 21:00 January 21 GMT – 21:00 January 24 GMT
               21:00 February 03 GMT – 21:00 February 08 GMT

4) Galactic Bazaar
•	Event Period: 21:00 January 24 GMT – 21:00 January 29 GMT
               21:00 February 08 GMT – 21:00 February 13 GMT

5)	Base Skin Bundle
•	Event Period: 21:00 January 27 GMT – 21:00 February 11 GMT

6)	Springfest Exclusive Skins
•	Event Period: After patch – 21:00 February 14 GMT

7)	Valentine Exclusive Skins
•	Event Period: 21:00 February 11 GMT – 21:00 February 26 GMT

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/dffb4167be1699bc4d335d6ee452ae82b5e0aa74.jpg[/img]
1.	Fixed the bug that the game would crash when checking unit upgrade.
2.	Fixed the problem that the Sand Basilisk still had its 30 bonus armor granted by the Submerge after it drilled out from the earth.
3.	Fixed the occasional issue that after unleashing the commander skill Flare, the Anti-Armor Interceptors’ attacks did not inflict damage.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.33 Notes: Winterfest, Balance Adjustment and More
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/e4d4d2dc2db6ba4c39811277d358fdfb02f8ac46.jpg[/img]
 
Greeting Commanders,

The server maintenance will take about 3 hours and be held on:
00:50 December 13 PDT
07:50 December 13 GMT
15:50 December 13 GMT+8
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

[h1]1. Winterfest will be live![/h1]
Event Period: After patch – 08:00 January 03, 2019 GMT
 
[b]1) Snow Town[/b]
• During the Winterfest, players have a great chance to enter the special map “Snow Town” in Quick Play or Ranked modes.
• Players may be rewarded with a Gift Box after a battle on the special map.
• Players will not be rewarded with the Gift Box in Versus A.I. mode or when they pass the Rested period.
 
[b]2) Gift Box[/b]
• Players have a great chance to get gingerbread men from the Gift Box. Gingerbread men can be used to exchange items in the Winterfest Store.
• Players may get a Winterfest exclusive skin, rune or avatar from the Gift Box.
 
[b]3) Winterfest Store[/b]
• In the Winterfest Store, players can exchange the Siege Tank’s Winterfest skins (Winterfest Tank Base, Winterfest Tank Convenience, Winterfest Tank Sport-Touring and Winterfest Tank Premium), avatars (Rudolph the Reindeer, White Beard, Red-Nosed Snowman and The Elkfather), runes and other items with gingerbread men.
• Items in the Winterfest Store will be automatically refreshed at 21:00 GMT every day. Players can also refresh them at the expense of some gingerbread men or gems.
• The Winterfest Store will be closed 1 week after the Winterfest ends.
 
[b]4) Winterfest Quest[/b]
• Complete the Winterfest quests during the event period to earn a large amount of gingerbread men.
 
[h1]2. Winterfest Exclusive Skin[/h1]
[b]1) Commander Skill Skin[/b]
I shall freeze you to your soul!
From after patch to 08:00 January 03, 2019 GMT, enjoy 50% off on the skin Frozen for the commander skill Orbital Cannon!
 
[b]2) Unit Skin[/b]
From after patch to 08:00 January 03, 2019 GMT, players can purchase the following Winterfest exclusive skins with eternium ingots: Nightwatch (Siege Tank), Snowtown Arsonist (Regular Flamethrower), Snow Arhat (Frost Arhat), Snow Clearer (Javelin Deer) and Uncle Bowcat (Bowcat).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]
The balance adjustment is based on tremendous match-up data. We’ve also analyzed the overall improvement according to players’ feedback. Balance adjustment is a long-term process, and sufficient amount of time is needed to make sure every adjustment is effective and reasonable. So please be patient and stay with us, our goal is to provide players with diverse strategies and better game experience.

[b]1. Illusionary Whale[/b]
Upgrade Adjustment:
Lv.1: No change
Lv.2: Armor increase lifted from 20 to 30.
Lv.3: Health +30%. Becomes cloaked once being activated. Acquires a buff that coexists with the illusion: armor increases by 50.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2b3fdb984957767a46729c992bd81bc19fd200a0.jpg[/img]
1.  Optimized the Sand Basilisk’s level 2 upgrade description.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/dffb4167be1699bc4d335d6ee452ae82b5e0aa74.jpg[/img]
1. Fixed the bug that the Assault Sentinel’s active ability stunned air targets.
2. Fixed the occasional problem in The Tactician Trials that Sand Basilisks and Multirole Tanks would move to the outside of the base range.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.32 Notes: New Units, Joint Operation and More
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/4204e98375688c25d5ac02492d685c2ffc014f4b.jpg[/img]
 
Greeting Commanders,
 
The server maintenance will take about 3 hours and be held on:
00:50 December 04 PDT
07:50 December 04 GMT
15:50 December 04 GMT+8
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]1.      New Units: The Aggressive Strikers Ⅱ[/h1]
1)      Assault Sentinel
Compared to other two kinds of sentinels, the Assault Sentinel has higher health and armor. It leaps into the battlefied and launches an energy shield upon landing.
•       Stats
Ground Mechanical | Anti-Ground | Active
•       Ability
Assault Leap | Machine Gun
 
2)      Illusionary Whale
As an advanced air unit of Atlac, the Illusionary Whale does not consume shield to attack. Instead, upon being activated, it consumes some shield to summon an illusion of itself. The illusion moves forward for a distance and then explodes, dealing much damage to nearby enemies.
•       Stats
Air Mechanical | Anti-Ground | AoE | Active
•       Ability
Imperial Decree | Illusion Burst
 
3)      Sand Basilisk
The Sand Basilisk is a basic Yaoguai unit. Upon being activated, it drills out from the earth and knocks nearby enemies into the air. Enemies hit can no longer be activated.
•       Stats
Ground Mechanical | Anti-Ground | AoE | Active
•       Ability
Submerge | Puncturing Claw
 
[h1]2.      New Unit Bundles: 25% Off for a Limited Time![/h1]
1)      Bundle Content
•       Assault Sentinel Bundle: Assault Sentinel, Vassago (Unit Skin), Coin Boost (1Win) *10, XP Boost (1Win) *10
•       Illusionary Whale Bundle: Illusionary Whale, Divine Lord (Unit Skin), Coin Boost (1Win) *10, XP Boost (1Win) *10
•       Sand Basilisk Bundle: Sand Basilisk, Underworld Basilisk (Unit Skin), Coin Boost (1Win) *10, XP Boost (1Win) *10
 
2)      Discount Period
December 04 after patch – 08:00 December 18 GMT
 
[h1]3.      1v1 Arena Mode: Joint Operation[/h1]
 
1)      Opening Time
December 04 after patch - 09:00 March 04 GMT
 
2)      Entry
• Click “Arena” in the home screen to enter the Joint Operation.
• Every day, players can attend 1 round for free, during which 5 victories or 2 defeats will end this round.
• For more rounds every day, players need to purchase tickets with coins. The more tickets you purchase, the higher the ticket price for next purchase. However, once your free round is reset in the next day, the ticket price will be also reset to the lowest point.
 
3)      Rules
• For each round, players need to choose 2 formations from two different races and enjoy both of their traits (Elite Troops/Transformation/Immolation).
• Players are allowed to choose 3 commander skills from all skills available to those races.
• The population cap is the average of the two chosen races.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2b3fdb984957767a46729c992bd81bc19fd200a0.jpg[/img]
1.      Optimized training by adding more instructions.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.30 Notes: Halloween, Balance Adjustment and More
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/5c6717cee17f29007fddc46eee250db60f8f238c.jpg[/img]

Greeting Commanders,

The server maintenance will take about 3 hours and be held on:
00:50 October 24 PDT
07:50 October 24 GMT
15:50 October 24 GMT+8
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]
[h1]1. Halloween is coming, the haunted night is among us![/h1]
Black mine has been attacked by unknown creatures. Who’s ever been there before use “the haunted mine” to describe that place.
“Trick or Treat” tee hee hee… A scary laughter reaches out to every corner of the black mine, please be very careful when you enter the map!

1) Event Period
October 24 after patch – 08:00 November 15 GMT
 
2) Haunted Mine
[list]
 [*]During the event, competing in Ranked and Quick Play has large chances to enter the Halloween map “Haunted Mine”.
 [*]After finishing the match, commanders will get a pumpkin chest.
 [*]Please note that commanders will not be rewarded with pumpkin chests in Versus A.I. mode, or when they pass the Rested period.
 [/list]
3) Pumpkin Coin
[list]
 [*]Pumpkin chest has a large chance to drop pumpkin coins. Pumpkin coins can be used to exchange Halloween rewards in the Haunted Store.
 [*]Regular loot chest might also contain a little amount of pumpkin coins.
 [*]First victory of the day will grant 200 coins and 100 bonus pumpkin coins.
 [/list] 
4) Haunted Store
[list]
 [*]Commanders can use pumpkin coins to exchange exclusive unit skins, runes and avatars in the Haunted Store.
 [*]The Haunted Store will be closed 1 week after the Halloween event ends. After that time, all remaining pumpkin coins will be locked away.
  [/list]
5) Achievement
[list]
 [*]Haunted Mine: Play 4/13/21 games on the Halloween map “Haunted Mine”
 [*]Ghostbuster: Get MVP for 4/13/21 times on the Halloween map “Haunted Mine”
 [*]Unlock an achievement to earn some gems. Unlock a three-star achievement to earn an exclusive avatar.
 [/list] 
[h1]2. Halloween Exclusive Skin[/h1]
Dress your units up and play tricks on your enemies!
 
1) Event Period
October 24 after patch – 08:00 November 15 GMT
 
2) Unit Skin
[list]
 [*]Sariel for the Sentinel, Azazel for the Infiltrator, Camael for the Marauder, Ghost Radar for the Mobile Radar, Underworld Gazer for the Gazer, Underworld Spellbreaker for the Spellbreaker Bee, Pumpkinhead Silklash for the Silklash Spider, and Underworld Treant for the Sprinting Treant.
 [*]Please note that the Sprinting Treant’s skin, Underworld Treant, can only be exchanged in the Haunted Store.
  [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]
The balance adjustment is based on tremendous match-up data. We’ve also analyzed the overall improvement according to players’ feedback. Balance adjustment is a long-term process, and sufficient amount of time is needed to make sure every adjustment is effective and reasonable. So please be patient and stay with us, our goal is to provide players with diverse strategies and better game experience.
 
[h1]1. Units[/h1]
Terran
Heavy Cruiser
Thunderbolt Missile: The Heavy Cruiser launches 6 anti-air missiles. Each missile hurts the target twice and deals 45 damage each time.
 
Atlac
Lightning Ray
Attack damage reduced from 20 to 18.
Lightning Surge: The Lightning Ray emits beams to continuously burn 2 targets, dealing 18 damage every 0.5s. After 6s, the damage decreases to 50%. The beams only deal 50% damage to buildings.
Upgrade Adjustment
Lv1: Attacks 3 targets simultaneously. Attack damage decreased to 80%.
Lv2: No change.
Lv3: Attacks 5 targets simultaneously. Attack damage decreased to 70%. Inflicts 250% damage on biological units.
 
Blind Skycrab
Ball Lightning: Attack range reduced from 22 to 18.
 
Yaoguai
Javelin Deer
Rotating Blade: After flying for a distance, rotating blade's attack damage will largely decrease.
Garuda
Ordeal: Attack range reduced from 23 to 20, attack damage reduced from 70 to 35, and cooldown increased from 1.8s to 2.4s.
 
Shadow Bat
Batling Swarm: Conjures up phantom and summons small bat at a faster speed.
 
Markscat
Rain of Arrows: The Markscat prioritizes targets of the highest value.
 
[h1]2. Commander Skills[/h1]
Terran
Airborne: Initial cost increased from 200 to 250, and initial cooldown increased from 60s to 100s.
 
Atlac
Lightning Tower: Initial cost increased from 200 to 250, and initial cooldown increased from 60s to 100s.
 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2b3fdb984957767a46729c992bd81bc19fd200a0.jpg[/img]
[olist]
[*] Optimized the description of Heavy Cruiser’s ability Thunderbolt Missile.
[*] Optimized the friend list system to avoid lags as much as possible.
 [/olist]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/dffb4167be1699bc4d335d6ee452ae82b5e0aa74.jpg[/img]
[olist]
[*] Fixed the bug that the Dragon Breath’s Combustion Improver lasted longer than expected.
[*] Fixed the overlapped interface problem caused by the incoming game invite while the player is watching the replay.
[*] Fixed the bug that the level 2 Lightning Ray did not reduce target’s armor.
[*] Fixed the bug that after the Soulblast Vajra was upgraded to level 2, its Reflective Armor did not have the 5 bonus damage reflection that was granted at level 1.
[*] Fixed the bug that the ability of the Staff Slave and the Swift Pangolin inflicted damage on air targets.
[*] Fixed the bug that the level 1 Anti-Armor Interceptor could attack 2 targets at a time, but this should have come to effect since level 2.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch 0.7.28 Notes: One Year Anniversary, New Unit Skins, Balance Adjustment and More
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/09b8af8ca9c6e97a7749ca740858b79856bf560c.jpg[/img]

Greeting Commanders, 

The server maintenance will take about 3 hours and be held on: 
00:50 September 20 PDT
07:50 September 20 GMT
15:50 September 20 GMT+8

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]
[h1]1.	Login Gift[/h1]
Login and celebrate the 1st anniversary of Art of War: Red Tides with us! Claim different gifts every day!

1)	Event Period
21:00 September 20 – 21:00 October 09 GMT

2)	Rules
*	During the event, go to “ANNIV” > “Login Gift” every day to claim EXP boosts, coin boosts, gems, skin pieces and more.
*	Login on September 26 to claim an anniversary exclusive avatar.
*	If commanders forget to claim gift the day/days before, they can claim them with gems or eternium ingots in chronological order.

[h1]2.	Unit Skin Pieces[/h1]
Complete the required events to piece together a legendary skin for the Dragon Breath!

1)	Event Period
September 20 after patch – 21:00 October 09 GMT

2)	How to Acquire
*	Complete the required events to earn unit skin pieces.
*	Filling 1 piece can earn 10 gems.
*	Commanders can collect up to 16 pieces. Once the limit is reached, then each piece gained will be changed to 20 gems.

3)	Unit Skin
*	Collect all 16 pieces to unlock the Dragon Breath's new skin Gotchihr.

[h1]3.	Anniversary Challenge[/h1]
Let’s fight together!

1)	Event Period
September 20 after patch - 21:00 October 09 GMT

2)	Description
All commanders destroy a total of 61,000,000 units.

3)	Rewards
*	When progress bar reaches 50% and 100% respectively, commanders can get a random reward by tapping the button “Claim”.
*	Rewards for 50% progress: 200 gems, 1 warzone change, 1 rune page, 20 Hardened Skin runes, or 999 cupcakes.
*	Rewards for 100% progress: 300 gems, 1 Terran formation slot, 1 Atlac formation slot, 1 Yaoguai formation slot, or 999 cupcakes.
*	If a commander did not claim reward when his/her progress reached 50%, s/he can claim 2 times when his/her progress reaches 100%.

[h1]4.	Cupcakes & Anniversary Store[/h1]
Exchange abundant supplies with sweet cupcakes!

1)	Cupcakes
*	Cupcakes are available from September 20 after patch to 21:00 October 06 GMT.
*	Competing in Ranked and Quick Play have large chances to earn cupcakes.
*	Completing some daily events can earn a large amount of cupcakes.
*	Please note that commanders will not be rewarded with cupcakes in Versus A.I. and Custom Game modes, or when they pass the Rested period.

2)	Anniversary Store
*	During the Anniversary Event, commanders can exchange exclusive avatars, runes and other items with cupcakes in the Anniversary Store.
*	Previous exclusive avatars might come back to the Anniversary Store.
*	The Anniversary Store will be closed on 21:00 October 09 GMT. After that, all remaining cupcakes will be locked away.

[h1]5.	Galactic Bazaar[/h1]
The Galactic Bazaar comes back!

1)	Opening Time
September 20 after patch – 21:00 September 25 GMT

2)	Rules
*	Commanders go to “Store” > “Galactic Bazaar” and click the button “Draw” on the right to get a random discount.
*	Commanders then click the cards arranged to the left side of the button to reveal items, and purchase them at the drawn discount.

3)	Items
*	Items sold in the Galactic Bazaar include units, runes, EXP boosts, coin boosts, name change, warzone change, unit skins, skill skins and base skins.
*	Commanders can reveal up to 15 cards, but are allowed to make 5 purchases only.
*	Once the card is revealed, it cannot be refreshed.

[h1]6.	Battle for More[/h1]
Burn yourselves and loot more!

1)	Coin Rush
*	Event period: September 20 after patch - 21:00 September 25 GMT
*	During the event, whether a commander passes the Rested Period or not, s/he can always gain 100% coins from each battle. Once the event ends, coins gained from battles will be reset to 0.
*	Subscription, base skins and coin boosts still grant bonus coins.

2)	More Supplies
*	Event period: 21:00 September 25 - 21:00 October 04 GMT
*	During the event, commanders gain double EXP and 1 loot chest after each battle.
*	Subscription still grants 1 bonus loot chest.

[h1]7.	Special Offers & Returns[/h1]
1)	Supply Drop
*	Event period: 21:00 September 25 – 21:00 September 30 GMT
*	During the event, there is a 25% off on all supply drops.

2)	Commander Skill Skin
*	Event period: 21:00 September 30 – 21:00 October 09 GMT
*	During the event, there is a 50% off on all commander skill skins.

3)	Eternium Ingots for Returns
*	Event period: September 20 after patch – 21:00 September 22 GMT, 21:00 September 30 – 21:00 October 03 GMT
*	During the event, purchasing eternium ingots grants some eternium ingots or cupcakes. Purchasing a certain amount grants unit skins.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]
The balance adjustment is based on tremendous match-up data. We’ve also analyzed the overall improvement according to players’ feedback. Balance adjustment is a long-term process, and sufficient amount of time is needed to make sure every adjustment is effective and reasonable. So please be patient and stay with us, our goal is to provide players with diverse strategies and better game experience.

[h1]1.	Terran[/h1]
Sentinel
Karna Missile prioritizes the target of the highest value.

Siege Tank
Upgrade Adjustment
Lv1: No change.
Lv2: Attack increased by 20 when in Siege Mode.
Lv3: No change.

Shadow Watch
Added a new ability Conceal: In the next 4s after the Shadow Watch throws the flash bomb, he won't be targeted by the enemies. But there’s a very short interval in between. At level 3, the Shadow Watch won't be targeted immediately after he throws the flash bomb.
Upgrade Adjustment
Lv1: Attack +10%. Won't be targeted for 6s after being activated.
Lv2: Attack +10%. Shoot deals true damage to enemies.
Lv3: No change.

Infiltrator
The attack range of Shoot increased from 18 to 20.

Grenadier
The attack range of Shoot increased from 18 to 20.

Heavy Cruiser
HP increased from 240 to 280, armor increased from 12 to 15, and movement speed increased from 10 to 10.5.
Upgrade Adjustment
Lv1: Armor increased to 20.
Lv2: Armor increased to 30.
Lv3: HP +20%.

[h1]2.	Atlac[/h1]
Blind Skycrab
Upgrade Adjustment
Lv1: With shield, it takes no more than 12 damage from each attack.
Lv2: No change.
Lv3: No change.

Skycrab
Ability cooldown reduced from 1.8s to 1.6s.

Vajra
Upgrade Adjustment
Lv1: Acquires shield and receives no more than 16 damage from each attack (does not work on incoming true damage).
Lv2: With shield, it takes no more than 12 damage from each attack.
Lv3: No change.

Azure Dragon
Fire Spit’s attack range increased from 28 to 30. Inflicts true damage on air targets.

[h1]3.	Yaoguai[/h1]
Swift Pangolin
Upgrade Adjustment
Lv1: No change.
Lv2: HP +10%. Digestive Acid deals 20 damage to up to 3 enemies.
Lv3: No change.

Shadow Bat
Batling Swarm’s cooldown reduced from 3s to 2.6s.

Sapphire Spider
Spiderling Attack’s cooldown reduced from 3s to 2.8s.

Bowcat
Aimed Shot’s attack range increased from 30 to 32.
Upgrade Adjustment
Lv1: Shoots 2 arrows at a time, dealing 150% damage in total.
Lv2: +30% attack speed.
Lv3: No change.

Markscat
Rapid Shot’s attack range increased from 26 to 30. Rain of Arrows’ attack range increased from 32 to 35, and damage increased from 40 to 52. The Markscat won’t be hurt by any damage reflection.
Upgrade Adjustment
Lv1: Casts Rain of Arrows every 6s.
Lv2: Attack +30%.
Lv3: No change.

[h1]Added “buff” and “debuff” in unit, unit ability and unit upgrade description to clarify that these effects can be removed by commander skill Flare. Meanwhile, clarified the damage and other value in some unit ability and unit upgrade description.[/h1]

notes.content:

[h1]1.	New 2v2 Arena Mode: Cursed Planet[/h1]
Push yourself to survive on and dominate this cursed planet!

1)	Opening Time
July 26 after patch - 09:00 September 27 GMT

2)	Rules
[list]
[*]The Cursed Planet is only available in 2v2 mode. Players are not allowed to use runes.
 [*]Each team can only ban 1 commander skill and 1 unit respectively.
 [*]In the Cursed Planet, all units are affected by the battlefield since spawned: maximum HP is reduced by 10%, armor is reduced by 2, and cloaked units are visible to non-detectors.
[*]Each turret of both sides will generate a healing field, which grants allies within 6% HP regeneration per second and prevent their maximum HP and armor from being affected by the battlefield. Note that units in the healing field of the opposite side will not get such buff.
[*]If one team loses any turret, this team's next wave of troops will get infuriated: attack speed is increased by 50%, attack damage is increased by 15, and the effects last until these troops are killed.
[*]In the final stage, all turrets, if there is any, will start to move and fight, and continue to generate healing field.
[/list]

3)	Rewards
[list]
[*]3 consecutive victories reward a small supply drop, and 5 consecutive victories reward a large one. Players can acquire one of the following items from a supply drop: runes (Mind Control-Range, Lightning Tower-Duration, Full Alert-Cost or Giant Catapult-Repair), the exclusive avatar Medal of Honor, or the skin Felfire Crow for the Firecrow.
[*]Players can also exchange the above items with arena coins in the Arena Store.
[*]Opening a certain amount of victories in the Cursed Planet can unlock the achievement “Planet Intruder” and some rewards. Three-star Planet Intruder grants its exclusive avatar.
[*]Opening a certain amount of large supply drops in the Cursed Planet can unlock the achievement “Planet Colonizer” and some rewards. Three-star Planet Colonizer grants its exclusive avatar.
[/list]

[h1]2.	New Units: The Aggressive Strikers[/h1]
1) Dragon Breath
Compared with those units under the same type, the Dragon Breath has higher HP and attack, but also higher research cost. Once activated, his flame can damage more enemies.
[list]
[*]Unit Info: Ground Biological, Anti-Ground, Active, AoE
[*]Unit Ability：Combustion Improver, Flame Burst, Fire Ball
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/1428b2e8a6b48bad69b589bd3f04c75e604ca067.png[/img]

2) Blademaster
As an advanced unit among the blade slave type, the Blademaster costs higher than the other 3 blade slaves. Permanently cloaked, Blademasters charge toward enemies and deal large damage to them.
[list]
[*]Unit Info: Ground Biological, Anti-Ground, Cloaked, Active, AoE
[*]Unit Ability：Blade Tempest, Wide Slash, Blade Dash
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/f86e850983982298898f5aa18d1a09c4ad276bd8.png[/img]

3) Garuda
The Garuda is an advanced unit of Yaoguai. It can only move on the ground and attack ground units at first. But after activating its active ability, it will ascend to the air and inflict area damage at the same time. Then it becomes an air-to-air unit and each of its attacks can damage multiple units at a time.
[list]
[*]Unit Info: Ground Biological, Anti-Ground, Active
[*]Unit Ability：Ordeal, Ascend to the Sky, Skyshatter
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/82cf8abc2938b4b3d4515a18f1cdee7de578a44a.png[/img]

4) From July 26 to August 09, themed bundles that respectively contains 1 new unit, some coins boosts and rune dust will be at 25% discount. Don’t miss out the limited time sale!

[h1]3.	Honor System[/h1]
Honor either teammates or opponents to make more friends!

1)	Rules
[list]
[*]The Honor system is available in Quick Play, Ranked and Arena. Versus A.I. and Custom Game modes are excluded.
[*]After the game ends, in the overview screen, players can honor more than 1 teammate and opponent, but cannot honor themselves.
[*]Times being honored can be found in the Player Information screen.
[/list]

2)	Achievement
[list]
[*]Great Teammate: honored by teammates 50/100/200 times
[*]Honorable Opponent: honored by opponents 50/100/200 times
[*]Achieving three-star of both can unlock the relevant avatars.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2b3fdb984957767a46729c992bd81bc19fd200a0.jpg[/img]
1.	Removed the Waves Cleared and K/D on the top of the battle screen.
2.	Optimized the scrolling notification in the battle screen.
3.	Added stats icons and the tech point icon to the unit production box in the battle screen. 
4.	Added “More Gems”, the guide on how to acquire gems in GUIDES.
5.	Optimized the tabs and race trait description in ARMY SETUP.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/dffb4167be1699bc4d335d6ee452ae82b5e0aa74.jpg[/img]
1.	Fixed the bug that after equipping the rune Ability Cooldown Reduction, Javelin Deer could not move while activated.

[h1]2. The featured Arena Mode – 1v1 Joint Operation is coming![/h1]

June 07 after patch - 09:00 August 16 GMT

• For each round, players need to choose 2 formations from two different races and enjoy both of their traits (Elite Troops/Transformation/Immolation).

• The population cap is the average of the two chosen races’.

Both the 3rd and 5th victory will grant a bonus supply drop.
• Players may acquire runes boosting commander skills from the supply drop.

[h1]New Units Arrive: The Disruptors[/h1]

[b]Shadow Watch[/b]
Vision control is the key to victory, and Shadow Watches specialize in it. In attacks, they prioritize detector units to keep enemy short of detection. They can also engage in combat with a well-timed flash bomb to blind all enemies in a large area, rendering them unable to target cloaked units.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/d45c0a8913933e82eebcaf7aa2de6b937fea5347.jpg[/img]

[b]Shock Hierophant[/b]
Being an Atlac creature with great electric power, the Shock Hierophant can be quite stunning — in many ways. Upon entering combat, the Shock Hierophant unleashes a raging thunder blast to hit enemies on sight. The targets hit will be stunned and have their armor greatly reduced for a duration.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/13f937e340bf53fa3d871561b259ba7a5c75b38d.jpg[/img]

[b]Sapphire Spider[/b]
As an artful hunter, the Sapphire Spider is always prepared. The cobweb it weaves is exquisite but deadly. Activating its ability, the Sapphire Spider spins the web towards enemies to stun and cripple them. The web lasts for a long duration and continuously stuns enemies that step in.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/9badc50a59990703850f80656f6246be6756241f.jpg[/img]

Themed bundles that individually contains one new unit and its skin will also be at 25% discount. Commanders can purchase each one of them with eternium ingots.

The bundles will be available after patch and expire on May 24.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]

[h1]1. Laborfest Event[/h1]

Grind your skills in the upcoming Laborfest for abundant rewards

[b]1)	Event Period[/b]
[list]
[*]April 20 after patch - May 10, 08:00 GMT
[/list]

[b]2)	Medal of Diligence[/b]
[list]
[*]Competing in Ranked and Quick Play have large chances to earn medals of diligence.
[*]Completing some daily events can earn a large amount of medals of diligence.
[/list]

[b]3)	Laborfest Chest[/b]
[list]
[*]330 medals of diligence are required to open a chest. The Laborfest chest contains the following rewards: new skins (Markscat - Elder Legend, Hailstorm - Jungle Assault, Storm Hierophant - Azure Executioner), exclusive avatars (Workaholic, Striver), runes and coins.
[/list]

[b]4)	Laborfest Leaderboard[/b]
During the Laborfest event, commanders will be ranked according to the total medals of diligence they have earned (including the spent ones). Once the event ends, commanders who achieve specific rankings will be rewarded accordingly:
[list]
[*]Top 50 commanders will be rewarded with the avatar “Grinder”, 300 rune dust, and 20 Coin Boosts (1Win).
[*]Commanders who rank between 51 and 200 will be rewarded with the avatar “Grinder”, 100 rune dust and 20 Coin Boosts (1Game).
[*]Commanders who rank between 201 and 500 will be rewarded with 50 rune dust and 15 XP Boosts (1 Win).
[*]Commanders who rank below 500 will be rewarded with 80 gems and 15 XP Boosts (1 Win).
[/list]
These rewards will be sent to in-game inbox once the Laborfest ends.

[h1]2. New Base Skin: Aldebaran[/h1]

The new base skin, Aldebaran, is about to land and will only be available for a limited time. Take the chance and dress up your base!

[b]1)	Available Time Period[/b]
[list]
[*]April 20 after patch - May 3, 08:00 GMT
[/list]
[b]2)	Features[/b]
[list]
[*]In games, the base of the Aldebaran owner’s side will be replaced by Aldebaran.
[*]A special mark will be entitled to the owner’s avatar.
[*]After the match ends, Aldebaran will grant 20% bonus XP and coins to each team member on the owner’s side. The bonus effect of multiple base skins do not stack.
[/list]

[b]3)	Acquisition[/b]
Go to “Store” > “Bundle” and purchase the New Base Skin Bundle.
 
[b]4)	How to Paint[/b]
[list]
[*]The base skin will be automatically painted upon purchasing.
[*]Or, go to home screen, tap the commander avatar in the top left corner. Tap commander avatar again, then tap “Base” > “Aldebaran” > “Replace”.
[/list]

[h1]3. New Unit Skins[/h1]
[list]
[*]Three new unit skins are coming to the Store: Elder Legend for the Markscat, Jungle Assault for the Hailstorm, and Azure Executioner for the Storm Hierophant.
[*]Commanders can either purchase them in the Store, or get them from the Laborfest Chest.
[/list]

notes.title: Update: New Game Mode – the Tactician Trial, New Units& Skins XP Gain
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a11ecbde172f174bd78dfe4d52b6d0492370f038.jpg[/img]

Greeting commanders,

We are excited to introduce you the new featured game mode – the Tactician Trial! In this new game mode, you can challenge top players and win substantial rewards. Now the skins can increase your XP gain! There are also three new units that will join to the battlefield. 

The server maintenance will take about 3 hours and be held on:
00:50 March 08 PDT
07:50 March 08 GMT
15:50 March 08 GMT+8

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

[h1]1. The new featured game mode – the Tactician Trial is coming![/h1]
Commanders can join the Tactician Trial by entering Casual Match – Master Challenge.
Now let’s go over the details:
[list]
[*]Players need to challenge 6 player who performed well in ranked matches the day before.
[*]Every day, the amount of soul essence and tech points a player can use in Master Challenge are fixed. 
[*]There will be no bonus soul essence nor tech points. Once a player passes a challenge, the amount of soul essence and tech points used in that challenge will not be returned. 
[*]Players should eliminate all enemy units in 30 seconds after the battle starts. Failing to do so leads to defeat.
[*]After a player passes a challenge, all units (exclude detectors) s/he has used in this challenge will be unavailable in that day.
[*]After a player passes all challenges that day, s/he will be rewarded based on his/her remaining percentage of soul essence. The higher the percentage, the more rewards s/he will gain.
[*]The Tactician Trial will be refreshed 13:00 PDT every day.
[/list]

[h1]2. Invisible Strikers - New units arrive to the battlefield[/h1]
[b]Stealth Cruiser[/b]
Stealth Cruiser has high defense but can only attack ground units. Its active ability can make it become invisible and do more single target damage.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/5c71a5e5bd9de8148fe36b4a6300f87b0bf1019d.jpg[/img]

[b]Shadow Blade Slave[/b]
Shadow Blade Slave is the nightmare of any squishy units. What is worth mentioning, he has the lowest cost among Atlac but can do tons of damage.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/0c715c964d3ac696a0275f1d413cbe3346c7cada.jpg[/img]

[b]Razorclaw Pangolin[/b]
Razorclaw Pangolin has higher HP, armor and attack damage than other Pangolins. Upon activating its ability, it will burrow into the ground and withdraw, restoring HP slowly.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/f8b28eaa849bfe22a3b4b40e041cf2aea5e5418f.jpg[/img]

[h1]3. Now the skins can increase your XP gain![/h1]
[list]
[*]Each skin can increase your XP gain after the battle for around 1% to 5%. Skin with higher quality has higher XP gain
[*]The XP for each skin will be accumulated in the match result 
[*]The XP gain will be effected no matter skins are painted or not
[*]There is no upper limit for the total XP gain
[*]Skins that commanders owned before the update will also have the XP gain effect
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2b3fdb984957767a46729c992bd81bc19fd200a0.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Optimized the in-game UI, now the battle information is more clear
[*]Added the ‘Stats’ button in Army Setup
[*]Added description for K/D, Waves Cleared and Bonus soul essence
[*]Optimized the UI in Command Academy, now the level details contain more information
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/dffb4167be1699bc4d335d6ee452ae82b5e0aa74.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Fixed the Win Rate display error in the leaderboard of Warzone 
[*]Fixed an error that occasionally happened when watch replay that shared by friends
[/list]

notes.title: Update: New Arena Mode - Desert Storm, Improvements&Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/02160ee1cb142a7e8a6b12443ed442aaa74c45e4.jpg[/img]

Greeting commanders,

We are excited to introduce you the new featured Arena mode – Desert Storm! In the Desert Storm, you can experience a new gameplay, random units, new traits Decommission and Expansion, random lv.7 runes and defense turret transformation. There are also substantial rewards, exclusive avatar and skin for challenging the Arena!

The server maintenance will take about 3 hours and be held on:
00:50 January 25 PDT
07:50 January 25 GMT
15:50 January 25 GMT+8

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

[h1]The new featured Arena Mode – Desert Storm is coming![/h1]
Now let’s go over the details:
[list]
[*]Random race: Commanders can enter Desert Storm by going to the Arena Mode. Before start, players will be presented with 2 races.
[*]Random units: Once a race has been selected, players will be shown 10 different sets of units, and each set contains different units. Players need to select 1 unit from each set to build a formation.
[*]Terran&Atlac: In the Desert Storm, Terran and Atlac keep their original traits Elite Troops and Transformation. In addition, they will have a new trait Decommission that has the same effect as Immolation (Units can be sold for a 90% cost refund and all research refund if all sold), but players can only set one unit for “Decommission”.
[*]Yaoguai: Yaoguai will keep the Immolation trait that can immolate 2 units. In addition, a new trait “Expansion” is added to Yaoguai. Expansion allows you to carry 1 extra unit at higher production and research costs, and that unit cannot be set for Immolation.
[*]Random ban: During the ban/pick phase, system will randomly ban two commander skills of each race.
[*]Random runes: Before the battle start, system offers four different colors of runes all at lv.7 for you to bring into the battle. Each rune has a chance to be replaced with a random rune.
[*]During the final turn (after 45 waves) in the Desert Storm map, the defense turrets of both teams would activate their Destroy Mode, transforming themselves into mobile bastions that will destroy enemies in their sight.
[list]
[*]The HP of the mobile bastions are based on the HP of defense turrets
[*]In the final turn, the outer and mid turrets will have the same stats, and the inner turret will be more powerful.
[*]The mobile bastions are ranged type and can inflict heavy AoE damage on enemies.
[*]The mobile bastions cannot be buffed or debuffed by units or commander skills.
[/list]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2b3fdb984957767a46729c992bd81bc19fd200a0.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Now you can block players after the match ends
[*]Optimized the beginner guides by adding few guides and in-game tips
[*]If match has been surrendered, it will not be added to Red Tides TV
[*]Now you can click the MVP highlight unit to check the unit details
[*]Continuously optimized the display of match result 
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/dffb4167be1699bc4d335d6ee452ae82b5e0aa74.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Fixed the problem that received an error mail from the system after the period of Arena ends.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused to crush when checking the info of a clan member who already left the clan.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused to crush when join clan chat
[*]Fixed a bug that after clicking the kill-streak announcement, the screen will show error by clicking other unit tips
[/list]

[*]Terran&Atlac: In the Desert Storm, Terran and Atlac keep their original traits Elite Troops and Transformation. In addition, they will have a new trait Decommission that has the same effect as Immolation (Units can be sold for a 90% cost refund and all research refund if all sold), but players can only set one unit for “Decommission”.
[*]Yaoguai: Yaoguai will keep the Immolation trait that can immolate 2 units. In addition, a new trait “Expansion” is added to Yaoguai. Expansion allows you to carry 1 extra unit at higher production and research costs, and that unit cannot be set for Immolation.
[*]Random ban: During the ban/pick phase, system will randomly ban two commander skills of each race.
[*]Random runes: Before the battle start, system offers four different colors of runes all at lv.7 for you to bring into the battle. Each rune has a chance to be replaced with a random rune.
[*]During the final turn (after 45 waves) in the Desert Storm map, the defense turrets of both teams would activate their Destroy Mode, transforming themselves into mobile bastions that will destroy enemies in their sight.
[list]
[*]The HP of the mobile bastions are based on the HP of defense turrets
[*]In the final turn, the outer and mid turrets will have the same stats, and the inner turret will be more powerful.
[*]The mobile bastions are ranged type and can inflict heavy AoE damage on enemies.
[*]The mobile bastions cannot be buffed or debuffed by units or commander skills.
[/list]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2b3fdb984957767a46729c992bd81bc19fd200a0.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Now you can block players after the match ends
[*]Optimized the beginner guides by adding few guides and in-game tips
[*]If match has been surrendered, it will not be added to Red Tides TV
[*]Now you can click the MVP highlight unit to check the unit details
[*]Continuously optimized the display of match result 
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/dffb4167be1699bc4d335d6ee452ae82b5e0aa74.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Fixed the problem that received an error mail from the system after the period of Arena ends.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused to crush when checking the info of a clan member who already left the clan.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused to crush when join clan chat
[*]Fixed a bug that after clicking the kill-streak announcement, the screen will show error by clicking other unit tips
[/list]

notes.title: Happy New Year, Dear Commanders!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/d190eb7068f6c00eedf3a44e4ad1a9cd1d0bb1f3.jpg[/img]

Time flies! We’re reaching the end of 2017. This time last year we marched on to Red Tides’ Open Beta on Steam, curious of this unknown world like newborn children. During 2017 we met many new commanders. They are lovely and sincere, giving us constant inspiration. The challenging year is coming to an end, but our expedition to the unknown continues. Now let’s talk about some of the great things that happened in 2017 as well as our plans in 2018.

In the year 2017, our Open Beta on Steam ended in January, and in June we launched the Early Access on Steam. In September we had the global release on the App Store, and Red Tides was recommended by App Store in 154 countries and regions. Then in December we were awarded Game of the Year by the App Store in China. We also fought together through Season 0, Season 1, and Winter League. We enjoyed the 1V1 Ranked, 2V2 Ranked, the Arena, Global Warzone, Halloween Event, and the Winterfest. We explored new maps such as Sunset Canyon, Black Mine, and Snow Town. Besides, we added the opening cinematic, and more importantly 10 other languages! We also developed systems like Command Academy, News, Events, Daily Quests, and Red Tides TV. The year 2017 witnessed Red Tides’ fantastic expedition in the unknown world. Our journey will continue in 2018!

Our plans for the coming year are as follows:
1. We plan to regularly release more units and skins.
2. This year we received messages concerning unit balance, so we will focus on balance adjustment. We may also rework some units. 
3. We plan to keep the Arena open, and introduce new modes to Arena.
4. Currently we’re considering re-opening 1V1 Ranked, which may be based on rules of Joint Operation.
5. In the aspect of battles, we will make adjustment to fix some long-existing problems, and see how it goes in the Arena. We’ll then decide whether to introduce such adjustments into other game modes. 
6. Thank you for loving the background story and art design of Red Tides. We will add more related content in the upcoming year! 

My dear commanders, see you in 2018!! 
The Art of War: Red Tides Team wish you Happy New Year!

notes.title: Update: Winterfest, New Units, Winter League, Improvements&Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/9e921f5cfb3fc093fc0e182dd3f7b8ff458b6e3d.jpg[/img]

Greeting Commanders,
	
There’s a winter season update coming to Red Tides tomorrow! We celebrate the Winterfest: there will be a new map – Snow town, upgradable Siege Tank skin and winter exclusive skins coming! We also introduce three new units to the battlefield, and a new season: 2017 Winter League.

The server maintenance will take about 5 hours and be held on:
00:50 December 15 PDT
08:50 December 15 GMT
14:50 December 15 GMT+8

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

[h1]1. Winter is coming! Be prepared for the Winterfest![/h1]
Event Period: December 15, 2017 – January 4, 2018

[b]Snow Town[/b]
[list]
[*]During the Winterfest, Players have a great chance to enter the special map ‘Snow Town’ in the Quick Play and Ranked modes.
[*]Players may be rewarded with a Gift Chest after a battle on the special map.
[*]Players will not be rewarded with the Gift Chest in Versus A.I. mode or when they pass the Rested period.
[/list]

[b]Gift Chest[/b]
[list]
[*]Players have a great chance to get gingerbread men from the Gift Chest. Gingerbread men can be used to exchange items in the Winterfest Store.
[*]Players may get a Winterfest exclusive skin, rune or avatar from the Gift Chest.
[/list]
[b]Winterfest Store[/b]
[list]
[*]In the Winterfest Store, players can exchange Winterfest exclusive skins, avatars, runes and other items with gingerbread men.
[*]Items in the Winterfest Store will be automatically refreshed at 05:00am (GMT+8) every day.
[*]Players can also refresh them at the expense of some gingerbread men or gems.
[*]The Winterfest Store will be closed 1 week after the Winterfest ends.
[/list]
[b]Siege Tank Skin Upgrade[/b]
[list]
[*]Players can pay the Blacksmith gingerbread men to upgrade the Siege Tank’s skin.
[*]The "Winterfest Series Skins" cannot be downgraded once levelled up. [*]Players will only own the Winterfest Tank Premium skin once they upgrade it to the highest level. 
[*]The Siege Tank Skin Upgrade will be closed 1 week after the Winterfest ends.
[/list]
[b]Winterfest Daily Quests[/b]
[list]
[*]There will be 3 new daily quests everyday. Complete them to get gingerbread men.
[*]Daily quests will be automatically refreshed at 05:00am (GMT+8) everyday.
[/list]

[h1]2. Winterfest exclusive skins[/h1]
Added 5 Winterfest exclusive skins in the store, and they can be exchanged in the Winterfest Store. ‘Snowtown Arsonist’ the Regular Flamethrower skin, ‘Snow Arhat’ the Frost Arhat skin, ‘Uncle Tom’ the Bowcat skin, ‘Nightwatch’ the Siege Tank skin, ‘Snow Clearer’ the Javelineer Deer skin. Exclusive skins are only available from December 15, 2017 to January 11, 2018

[h1]3. New Units – Hailstorm, Tempest Dragon and Venom Deer arrive at the battlefield![/h1]

[b]Hailstorm[/b]
The Hailstorm is able to launch missile barrage to a target area at a super long distance. It is very effective along with False Rally

[b]Tempest Dragon[/b]
The Atlac gets another late-game CHAMP! Not only Tempest Dragon’s normal attack can deal AoE damage, its active ability can cast a tornado that deals massive damage!

[b]Javelineer Deer[/b]
As a support unit, Javelineer Deer wants to be the carry of the team. Javelineer Deer can turn its javelin to a spiral blade that deals long range AoE damage when using active ability.  

[h1]4. 2017 Winter League[/h1]
Winter is coming! The long-awaited Winter League will start on December 14!
[list]
[*]Winter League will start after the weekly update on December 14 and end before the weekly update on January 11, 2018
[*]Player records/history relating to ranks and tiers in S1 will be cleared. Commanders need to start from scratch on a new Leaderboard.
[*]Commanders achieved at least Platinum will be awarded with special avatars representing the highest tier they achieved in the Winter League.
[*]Commanders achieved at least Gold will be awarded with Grand Duchess Zern, the limited edition skin for the Regular Paviser.
[*]Commanders will get one of the following rewards according to the highest tier they achieved in the Winter League:
[list]
[*]300 gems for Bronze
[*]500 gems for Silver
[*]1000 gems and the limited edition skin ‘Grand Duchess Zern’ for Gold
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/0482d6d1bfa56e8d2e776bfad96c9cb11d390d7c.jpg[/img]
[*]1500 gems, the limited edition skin ‘Grand Duchess Zern’ and the honorable avatar Wolf for Platinum
[*]2000 gems, the limited edition skin ‘Grand Duchess Zern’ and the honorable avatar Alpha Wolf for Diamond
[*]3000 gems, the limited edition skin ‘Grand Duchess Zern’ and the honorable avatar Wolf King for Supreme Commander
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]5. Daily Quests redesigned![/h1]
We redesigned the daily quests system. The original daily quests system and Daily Sale Bundle have moved to Events system. Now there will be many rewards after finishing each daily quest, including coins, rune dust and gems. 

[h1]6. Teammates position swap[/h1]
After ban pick in each game, there will be 20-second preparation time for position swap. Commanders can swap with teammates for their most comfortable position.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]
The balance adjustment are based on tremendous match-up data. We’ve also analyzed the overall improvement according to players’ feedback. Balance adjustment is a long-term process, and sufficient amount of time is needed to make sure every adjustment is effective and reasonable. So please be patient and stay with us, our goal is to provide players with diverse strategies and better game experience.

[h1]Atlac[/h1]

[b]Units[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a708dfb4225e86b3ae4ddb7590eaa0e46b9f95a0.png[/img]
Upgrade Adjustment:
Lv1. Fast Recharge time increased to 5s, recharge shield at 20/0.5s
Lv2. Invulnerable when recharging.
Lv3. Shield + 40%

[h1]Yaoguai[/h1]

[b]Units[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eda011899e4139e8145875c0df09a71cc23f745e.png[/img]
Upgrade Adjustment:
Lv1. Units attacked by frost bolts will be slowed for 3 seconds. Cloaked units attacked by fire bolts will be visible
Lv2. Gains detect ability permanently
Lv3. When both fire and frost bolts hit the target, bolts will explode and deal AoE damage

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2b3fdb984957767a46729c992bd81bc19fd200a0.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Optimized the match overview. Match results in ‘Economy’ tab changed to curve chart
[*]Continuously optimized the in-game Tips
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/dffb4167be1699bc4d335d6ee452ae82b5e0aa74.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Fixed the problem that command academy level4 was unplayable
[*]Fixed the problem that caused the vision of enemy base appeared
[*]Fixed the problem that units affected by Shrink lost attack animation
[*]Fixed the problem that the Dreadclaw can be affected by stun
[/list]

notes.title: Update: Runes Reforge System, Balance Adjustment, Improvement&Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/aa22c98fac7ad3aa422e0ce51858b88d5c505c5f.jpg[/img]

Greeting Commanders,
	
There’s a huge new update coming to Red Tides tomorrow! We introduce the Runes Reforge system that allows you to melt the spare runes and reforge the wanted runes. We also make units balance adjustment, optimize the match overview and fixes several bugs.

The server maintenance will take about 2 hours and be held on:
00:50 November 30 PDT
08:50 November 30 GMT
15:50 November 30 GMT+8

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

[h1]1. Runes reforge system is available![/h1]
Melt: Commander can select the spare runes to melt for a certain amount of Rune Dust
Reforge: Use Rune Dust to reforge the wanted runes

[b]Runes Melting Rules:[/b]
Runes cannot be downgraded or destroyed when be chosen to melt

[b]Runes Reforging Rules:[/b]
Use Rune Dust to reforge the wanted runes. Runes cannot be reforged when they reach level7. Player will be informed the needed amount of runes to upgrade to the next level

[h1]2. Optimized the match overview[/h1]
Optimized the MVP display. Now the final MVP display includes commander name, units, total coins and soul essence collected, number of waves cleared and K/D. We also optimized the ‘Overview’ and ‘Unit’ tab.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]
The balance adjustment are based on tremendous match-up data. We’ve also analyzed the overall improvement according to players’ feedback. Balance adjustment is a long-term process, and sufficient amount of time is needed to make sure every adjustment is effective and reasonable. So please be patient and stay with us, our goal is to provide players with diverse strategies and better game experience.

[h1]Terran[/h1]

[b]Units[/b]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/777d6fcee1fd440ae20ea12030ce4457cad9df30.png[/img]
Repairs a single mechanical unit within its 20 radius, restoring 20HP for it every 0.5s
Upgrade adjustment:
Lv1. HP restored increased by 30%
Lv2. Repair grants 7% bonus HP to the target
Lv3. Repair 2 units at the same time

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/45e6ee06aab584be710b3c44269f088807aa9eb7.png[/img]
Now the Enhancement Engineer will not enhance units that cannot attack/cause damage, such as Scouts

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/15a9d956b443f89ed96ac9bacf800c645885269b.png[/img]
HP increased from 400 to 480, armor increased from 10 to 12, movement speed increased to 10.5; Attack range increased to 22 when in Bastion Mode, and gains a barrier that will clear energy orbs(Chan Masters’ orb or Hierophants’ orb) within.

[h1]Atlac[/h1]

[b]Units[/b]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/cde8d3c3828dba184cad7fd7f8921f7923cc4bef.png[/img]
HP increased from 100 to 150, active ability only deals 12.5% damage to the building

[h1]Yaoguai[/h1]

[b]Units[/b]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/6cc3158b6dfaf1cf112278170cd8c88eb4f28698.png[/img]
HP increased from 50 to 70, Blink Strike will not attack neutral units

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/b14616e8e2050f2894393cc423fab031bb730af2.png[/img]
No longer deal more damage to the building
New ability – Morale Boost: increases the attack of two highest cost friendly units. Its cooldown time is 10s
Upgrade Adjustment:
Lv1. Morale Boost takes effect on 3 friendly units
Lv2. Morale Boost increases friendly units’ attack speed and restore 2.5% of their max. HP per second
Lv3. Morale Boost takes effect on 4 friendly units

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2b3fdb984957767a46729c992bd81bc19fd200a0.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]One free ticket every 5 day changed to one free ticket a day for the Arena
[*]Added countdown clock to the Arena Mode
[*]Skins will be painted automatically after receiving them
[*]Increased the starting cool-down time of commander skills
[*]Optimized the in-game tips, now the in-game tips will be more clear and intelligible to follow
[*]Added Units Kill-Streak announcement in 3v3 mode
[*]Commanders can now check what a unit looks like in different skins in the Unit Info
[*]Added three Halloween related runes to the Store
[*]Added the description of ’The Ancient Egg has 15 armors’, so units with attack lower than 15 cannot deal damage to the Ancient Egg 
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/dffb4167be1699bc4d335d6ee452ae82b5e0aa74.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Fixed the problem that Butcher cannot move when affected by Full Alert
[*]Fixed the problem that Ironbird Riders could not be affected by False Rally
[*]Fixed the problem that units usage rate dropped to negative percentage or total usage rate equaled 99% in the leaderboard
[*]Fixed the bug that Friends list keeps alternating
[*]Added back the missing sound effect for some commander skills, such as Bombing Run
[/list]
We hope you enjoy these latest changes to The Art of War: Red Tides. Your advice and feedback are valuable, so don’t hesitate to share any thoughts on the game with us! 

See you on the battlefield,
The Art of War: Red Tides Team

notes.title: Update: New Units Join the Battle!
notes.content:
Greeting Commanders,
	
There’s a huge new update coming to Red Tides tomorrow! Three new ground units will join the battlefield. We introduce the Events system so you won’t miss out on any events or rewards. we also launch the News system, commanders can get all the information and keep up with the newest changes in the game.
The server maintenance will take about 3 hours and be held on:
00:50 November 16 PDT
08:50 November 16 GMT
15:50 November 16 GMT+8

[h1]Important Updates [/h1]

[h1]New units arrive! [/h1]

[b]Heavy Tank[/b]
The Heavy Tank is a strong defensive unit. It can turn into a bastion with its active ability. When in bastion mode, the Heavy Tank can be the toughest fortification that able to absorb damage and protect teammates 

[b]Soulblast Vajra[/b]
With hellfire burning on its armor, the Soulblast Vajra will reflect some damage to the attacker. It can also explode the armor to deal massive damage to enemies around it

[b]Dreadclaw[/b]
When the Dreadclaws enter into the battlefield, they can turn into shadow and strike the enemies. After being upgraded, they can gain the ability of Bloodthirst and leave illusions in the battlefield to confuse their enemies.

[h1]2. In-game Events system is available! [/h1]
From daily events to holiday events, Red Tides has lots of events and activities to offer. For the sake of convenience, we added the Events system into the game. Now commanders can follow the new challenging events and complete them for huge rewards!

[h1]3. News system is launched! [/h1]
Commanders can open the News system from the right top of main interface. The News system includes balance adjustment, new units preview and new game mode that you don’t want to miss. It also includes many game information and strategies from the community and more. Keep up with the newest update and be the best player in game!

[h1]4. Hint for the enemy unit with the highest threat[/h1]
Optimized the unit evaluation. Now the main screen will show the enemy unit with the highest threat after each wave, so that commanders can counter that unit easier.

[h1]Balance Adjustment[/h1]
The balance adjustment are based on tremendous match-up data from the game. We’ve also analyzed the overall improvement according to players’ feedback. Balance adjustment is a long-term process, and sufficient amount of time is needed to make sure every adjustment is effective and reasonable. So please be patient and stay with us, our goal is to provide players with diverse strategies and better game experience.

[h1]Terran[/h1]
[b]Units[/b]

[b]Enhancement Engineer[/b]
The Enhancement Engineer now will not increase the attack of air-unit
Upgrade adjustment:
Lv1. Remain the same
Lv2. Remain the same
Lv3. The attack range of the 3 enhanced friendly units changed to 5

[h1]Yaoguai[/h1]
[b]Units[/b]

[b]Hippogryph[/b]
HP increased from 120 to 150, attack increased from 35 to 50
Upgrade adjustment:
Lv1. Units attacked by frost bolts will be slow for 3 seconds
Lv2. Cloaked units attacked by fire bolts will be visible
Lv3. When both fire and frost bolts hit the target, bolts will explode and deal AoE damage

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed the attack stats of Scout, Engineers, Shadow Fish, Void Fish and Beholder to zero
[*]Fixed the problem of missing attack animation by the neutral unit Dragon Cub 
[*]Fixed several bug that will cause the game to crash
[*]Fixed the problem of some units’ sound effect becoming invalid
[/list]

notes.title: Update: The Joint Operation and Balance Adjustment
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/b0c29b38a7dd9eff183689e4689a8cc8166832e4.jpg[/img]

Greeting Commanders,
	
We are excited to announce that the Joint Operation is returning to Arena again! This time we bring back the 18s turn-based system for the Joint Operation. We also adjust the balance of some not commonly used units in this update.
The server maintenance will take about 2 hours and be held on:
00:50 November 2nd PDT
08:50 November 2nd GMT
15:50 November 2nd GMT+8

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]
[h1]1. The Joint Operation is coming back![/h1]
The Joint Operation is back with slow-paced 18s each turn and more strategies. Essence mine collecting rate in Joint Operation is decreased to 25/s in wave 1, 40/s in wave 10 and 80/s in wave 30. 

 [b]Joint Operation Rules[/b]
[list]
  [*]For each battle, players need to choose 2 formations from two different 
  races.
  [*]Players are allowed to choose 3 commander skills from all skills 
   available to those races.
  [*]Two defeats or five victories will end a round in Joint Operation.
  [*]Players can choose to quit, but they need to claim all rewards before 
  quitting
[/list]
  [b]New Arena Store[/b]
[list]
  [*]Commanders will receive Arena Coins in the first, second and fourth victory
  [*]For the third and fifth victory, commanders will receive Arena Supply Drop. 
  A Supply Drop contains Runes for boosting commander skills and a special 
  avatar. Supply Drop also has a slight chance to contain exclusive skin
  [*]If you are not lucky enough, don’t worry! You can buy exclusive skin, 
  special avatar, runes and coins in the Arena Store by spending Arena Coins
  [*]The Arena Store will still open after the Joint Operation ends.
[/list]
[h1]2. Additional Halloween Exclusive Skins[/h1]
Added 2 new Halloween exclusive skins to the store. ‘Ghost Radar’ the Mobile Radar and ‘Underworld Spellbreaker’ the Spellbreaker Bee. They are only available in the store from 02:50 November 2, PDT to 00:50 November 16, PDT

[h1]3. Four popular unit skins are also available in the store[/h1]

Greeting Commanders,

[b]Gorilla[/b]
Gorillas are very effective against mechanical troops. They have faster shooting rate than the Marauders, but less defensive.


[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/66e1375f439bdb2f128731d90da41ae39afa6bb1.png[/img]
[b]Gospel Chanter[/b]
The Gospel Chanter is a high cost-effective support. Its Recharging Field makes Atlac basic units last longer in the battle and gains advantages at early stage. 


[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/6029024f8aac49121b38451138f111f7debb89dc.png[/img]
[b]Mammoth Vanguard[/b]
The Mammoth Vanguard can charge to break through enemy lines and soak up damage for friendly units


[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

[h1]1. Opening CG[/h1]

Implemented the opening CG. It will be automatically played once commanders log-in. Commanders can also find the CG from the steam login screen

[h1]2. Halloween is coming, the haunted night is among us[/h1]
[list]
[*]Black mine has been attacked by unknown creatures. Who’s ever been there before use ‘The haunted mine’ to describe that place
[*]‘Trick or Treat’ Teeheehee… A scary laughter reaches out to every corners of the black mine, please be very careful when you enter the map! 
[/list]

[b]Event Rules[/b]

Event Period: 10/19/2017 ~ 11/09/2017 GMT+8

[b]The Haunted Mine[/b]

During the event, there is a great probability to enter the event map ‘The Haunted Mine’.
After finishing the match, commanders will get a pumpkin chest.
First victory of the day will get 200coins + additional 100 pumpkin coins.
Please note that plays in the A.I. mode or passes the rested period will not get pumpkin chest.

[b]Pumpkin Chest[/b]

Pumpkin chest has a large probability to drop pumpkin coins, pumpkin coins can be used to exchange Halloween rewards in the Event Store.
A pumpkin chest has a little chance to contain exclusive Skins, Runes and Avatars.
Regular loot chest might also contain a little amount of pumpkin coins.

[b]Event Store[/b]

Commander can use pumpkin coins to exchange exclusive Skins, Runes and Avatars in the Event Store. Event Store will be automatically refreshed every 5pm EST during the event, commanders can also use pumpkin coins or gems to refresh the store
After the Halloween event, if commanders still have pumpkin coins left, they can continue to exchange rewards in the event store. The event store will be closed at 4 am EST, a week after the Halloween event ends, and pumpkin coins will be discarded after that time.

[b]Halloween Exclusive Skin[/b]

Added 6 Halloween exclusive skins in the store. ‘Underworld Treant’ the Sprinting Treant skin can only be exchanged in the event store. Halloween exclusive skins are only available from 6am EST, 10/19 to 4am EST, 11/16.

[h1]3. S1 season[/h1]

The long-awaited Season One will start after this update!
[list]
[*]Season One will start after the weekly update on October 19th and end before the weekly update on December 14th.
[*]Player records/history relating to ranks and tiers in the Preseason will be cleared. Commanders need to start from scratch on a new Leaderboard.
[*]Commanders achieved at least Platinum will be awarded with special avatars representing the highest tier they achieved in the Season One.
[*]Commanders achieved at least Gold will be awarded with Born of Fire, the limited edition skin for the Steelhorn Minotaur.
[*]Commanders will get one of the following rewards according to the highest tier they achieved in the Season One:
 1. 300 gems for Bronze
 2. 500 gems for Silver
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/f41cee0726c3cf92b972b24e482a2ac280d9d22b.jpg[/img]
 3. 1000 gems and Born of Fire, the limited edition skin for the Steelhorn Minotaur for Gold
 4. 1500 gems, the limited edition skin Born of Fire and the honorable avatar Platinum General for Platinum
 5. 2000 gems, the limited edition skin Born of Fire and the honorable avatar Diamond General for Diamond
 6. 3000 gems, the limited edition skin Born of Fire and the honorable avatar Supreme Commander for Supreme Commander
[/list]
[h1]4. 2v2 will be temporary closed[/h1]

During the preseason, 2v2 has been a great ranked mode. But throughout this season’s observation, we found out that 2v2 has a lot of room to improve. So we decided to temporary close 2v2 ranked in order to optimize it. 2v2 will open again once we finish optimization.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]

What we did to the balance adjustment are based on tremendous match-up data from the game, and analyze the overall improvement relied on player’s feedback. Balance adjustment will be a long-term process, sufficient amount of time is needed to make sure every adjustment is effective and sound reasonable, so please be patient and stay with us, our goal is to provide players with diverse strategies and better game experience.

The Lightning Ray only deals 50% damage to building 

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/aab160f1423a6393b666016b485e063e39c96d59.png[/img]
Attack up to 2 air units at once, deals 30 damage to each and reducing their armor by 20 for 99s
Upgrade adjustment:

HP increased from 90 to 100, shield increased from 90 to 100

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a7282bce46dce938a28d702b656dc7f140770ad4.png[/img]
Attack increased from 80 to 100, HP increased from 90 to 100, shield increased from 90 to 100
Upgrade adjustment:

Lv2: Burning area deals 15 true damage to enemies each second, Unicorn inflicts 250% damage to biological units
	Lv3: No change

[list]
[*]Fixed the problem when neutral units being killed by Mega-Beam Cannon, the kills count might goes to the enemy side

[list]
Added 1 second global cooldown for each Commander Skill
[/list]

notes.title: Art of War: Red Tides iOS Global Launch
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/49ce503714ace1e0f0223c9531788f434084158d.jpg[/img]
Greeting Commanders,

Very happy to share with you guys that we are going to launch Art of War: Red Tides on App Store in 154 countries and regions on September 29th. But sadly, both publisher and developer team still haven’t reconciled with the policies on different platforms. In other words, Commanders from Steam are not able to play against Commanders using iOS devices for the time being.

As we mentioned many times, our intention of making Red Tides is to break the barrier of each platform, so that Commanders from around the world can enjoy playing together on any devices they are comfortable with, and at any time. Technically speaking, we already have the game working on iPad, smart phones, and PC internally. So we definitely aware that Commanders are anxious regard to this situation, and we share the same feeling too.

That being said, since we can’t really estimate the time that will cost to reconcile with those policies, so before the cross-platform play is ready, the dev team will commit to these:
[list]
[*]Make sure that Steam has the newest version among all platforms
[*]Value the game development process of each platform as the same priority
[*]Put more efforts on the server performance and connection
[*]Maintain our community management and respond to bug reports and feedback in time 
[*]Send out 500 gems each month via in-game mailbox, until the cross-platform play is ready
[/list]
Both developer and publisher team will maintain actively communication to each platform. Once again, we apologize for any inconvenience, if there is any progress we will be sure to inform you.

notes.title: Update: Command Academy, Balance Adjustment and Optimization
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/e680aad73d0907d024f69fc0320ff8f600d1a492.jpg[/img]

Greeting Commanders:
	
We’re happy to announce that the new update is now available with the following new content: Command Academy, a single player mode that can help new commanders and bring some challenges to veteran commanders. Also featuring the second patch of War Zone, now commander can select country and fight with honor!

The server maintenance will take about 2 hours and be held on:

00:50 PDT September 19th 
08:50 GMT September 19th 
15:50 GMT+8 September 19th 

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

[h1]1. Command Academy come on stage! [/h1]

[b]Introduction[/b]
Command Academy aims at helping commanders get familiar with all the units, learn strategies and prepare them for the further competition. Commander can scroll through the enemy’s army setup to determine what units to build by using fixed amount of essences. 
There are totally 36 game levels, commander can unlock new ones by leveling up.

[b]Achievement and Rewards[/b]

Honors Student: Successfully pass the 1/18/36 academy levels, and you will be rewarded with Coins and Avatar.
Successfully pass each level the first time and you will be rewarded with Coins and Gems, repeatedly challenge will not receive any rewards. 

[h1]2. War Zone the second patch, global conflict setting off! [/h1]

Removed United Front and Federation war zone. Commanders' Warzone Country will be assigned to their physical location. Some of the commander will be assigned to international alliance, in the future we will have more country war zone in order to allow commanders to serve their own country. If you were not assigned to the correct War Zone, don’t worry, you can change your War Zone for free once, after that you will need to buy the Warzone Change.
War Zone conflict has been set to two tiers, the first tier is Allied Team VS National Team, the second tier is National Team VS National Team:
[list]
[*]National Team includes three commanders with the same War Zone, otherwise is Allied Team
[*]The First Tier matches will receive half contribution as the second tier
[*]Added War Zone matches chest drop, and completing the second tier will be rewarded with Chest
[*]Temporarily closed region leaderboard, it will be reopened soon after optimization
[*]When the second tier match was encountered, commander’s Avatar will be replaced with National banner Avatar
[/list]
Since the rules of National Banner Avatar has been redesigned, we reclaimed all the National Banner Avatar. Now commanders’ Avatar will have their War Zone Flag shown on the bottom left.

[h1]3. 2v2 Ranked will be closed temporarily in the near future [/h1]

During Season 0, 2v2 had been very popular and it has exceeded our expectation. But through observation on Season 0, we found out that 2v2 Ranked still can be optimized. Within a few days, we will temporarily close 2v2 Ranked to optimize its features, it will be reopened after that.


[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]

What we did to the balance adjustment are based on tremendous match-up data from the game, and analyze the overall improvement relied on player’s feedback. Balance adjustment will be a long-term process, sufficient amount of time is needed to make sure every adjustment is effective and sound reasonable, so please be patient and stay with us, our goal is to provide players with diverse strategies and better game experience. 

We optimized the fast-pace gameplay by increasing the initial speed of all units and decreasing all units’ HP
