notes.title: Some Thoughts about the Clan System
notes.content:
Recently we received some suggestions from community about the Clan system, now is the time for us to talk about the concept of design.

[h1] Clan plays different roles in different kinds of game: [/h1]
In RPG Game, Clan (Guild) is like a benefit community, carrying the important game numerical growth, so player’s sunk costs are very high in the clan, in other words, player need to spend much time and effort along with the clan growth.

In Casual Game, clan is a platform that makes it easy to connect with friends in-game, providing a better way for players to showcase themselves and to become friends with other players. So clan is more like a social networking tool.

[h1] So what role should Clan play in Competitive Game? [/h1]
We can refer to a real life situation: what do we really want when we are in a basketball team? First we need a bunch of teammates in order to form a team. Then we need to practice a lot with teammates to make sure that players can be coordinated with each other and win the game. If the team happens to have a leaderboard and personal stats, that will be great. If not, then it is fine just to play around.

[h1] Similar to the basketball team, the next development directions for Clan system are as follows: [/h1]
[olist]
[*]The most important feature is auto-translation in game. We will set this feature to the highest priority, no matter how much it costs, to settle the cross-language communication problem.
[*]Then we need better support for Clan, that include to look for a team more easily, to share game replays with each other, and to practice or compete in the clan.
[*]The last one is competition between Clans, but this part has very low priority. We think the more important part is the Art of War: Red Tides should be fun to play for over 1,000 hours even without any additional features.
[/olist]
At this point, your comment and suggestions will be much appreciated and welcomed, although we can’t get back to every one of you, but please be assured that, your advice will be reviewed and assessed by game designers. You are also welcome to contact us by email: support@gamesci.com.cn.

The Art of War: Red Tides is getting better with the help from community, once again thank you for the time you spent reading this article.

notes.title: Update: Global War Zone, Speeding up gameplay, Balance&Bug fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/396169b9cb029a852d3039bb961dd4651f697caf.jpg[/img]

Greeting Commanders!

An exciting update approaches! With this major patch, we are bringing you the Global War Zone, commanders can represent their war zone and fight for the glory! We also speed-up the entire gameplay, which guarantee the fast-paced game features and reduce the total game time. Update also includes some balance adjustment and bug fixes. 

The server maintenance will take about 2 hours and be held on:

00:50 PDT September 1st
08:50 GMT September 1st
15:50 GMT+8 September 1st

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

[h1] 1. Global War Zone, Fight for your Glory! [/h1]

[b] Introduction [/b]

Global War Zone system is released in this update, based on your location, commanders are divided into two War Zone: United Front and The Federation. Enter the global war zone system in the main interface, commanders can reset their war zone, check war zone record and leaderboard, get the information of your war zone levels and contribution.

[b] How to start a War Zone Battle? [/b]

When commanders queue for a 3v3 Ranked game, if both teams are belong to two different war zones, then the system has a chance will trigger a war zone battle, in the preparation phase, both teams will need to ban/pick for units and commander skills just as in Ranked mode.

[b] Rules [/b]

After competition, both team can receive battle points, the winner team receive more points. Battle points will turn into war zone power, used for promoting war zone, battle points will also increase your war zone level.

[b] War Zone Achievement [/b]

Frontier Warrior: War Zone levels reach to 10/50/100, stage1/2 is rewarded with Gems, stage3 is rewarded with special Avatar
Blood Prime: Won 1/50/100 war zone battles, stage1/2 is rewarded with Gems, stage3 is rewarded with special Avatar

[h1] 2. Speed-up the gameplay [/h1]

Decrease the time of each turn from 18 seconds to 12 seconds
Essence mine collecting rate increased from 25/40/80 to 35/75/120

[h1] 3. Adding brand new battle feedback [/h1]

Now new commanders will receive an in-game voice guide for deploying the appropriate units
System will display our side and enemy side’s most-killed units, to let you know which unit has the most threat

[h1] 4. Arena is closed [/h1]

Arena – Joint Operation is officially ended, we are really appreciated your active experiencing and feedback during this time. Arena will be back in the near future, gameplay might be replaced. We will change the way of getting the final prize instead of getting from boxes by luck, so the unlucky commanders can also achieve the final prize by continuously play in the Arena

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]

What we did to the balance adjustment are based on tremendous match-up data from the game, and analyze the overall improvement relied on player’s feedback. Balance adjustment will be a long-term process, sufficient amount of time is needed to make sure every adjustment is effective and sound reasonable, so please be patient and stay with us, our goal is to provide players with diverse strategies and better game experience.

notes.title: Update: New map, 2V2, New Terran Trait, Balance&Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/98f7310fecfc4ef5b66bd98ef72df15141a38b15.jpg[/img]

Hello, Commanders!

New patch is upon us! Featuring a brand new map: Sunset Canyon, new neutral units, exciting 2V2 mode, new Terran trait, and auto-upgrading essence mine. With all that excited contents and changes, more strategies will come into the game and less ‘mouse-clicking’, team up with your friend and head over to Red Tides for real time 2v2 battles! 
The server maintenance will take about 2 hours and be held on:

[b]00:50 PDT August 22[/b]
[b]07:50 GMT August 22[/b]
[b]15:50 GMT+8 August 22[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Map: Sunset Canyon[/h1]
[list]
    [*]In the early game, break the Statues in the middle of battlefield, you will get a population cap for your team
    [*]Statues can be attacked by Anti-air and Anti-ground units
    [*]When the Capsule in the middle of statues is broke by player, it will summon three Shadow Warriors to fight for that player.
    [*]Waves 25, Sarcophagus of Shadows breaks through the surface, then release shadow waves to surrounding, shadow waves cannot damage cloaked units, but will deal massive damage to units that uncloaked. When the Sarcophagus is broke by player, that player will earn some population caps again
    [*]When Sarcophagus of Shadows is broke by player, Belial, the Lord of Shadow appears into the battlefield, 
    [*]Commanders under certain levels cannot encounter this new map
[/list]

[h1]2V2 is available, team up with your friend to take over the battle![/h1]
[list]
    [*]2V2 Ranked mode is opened, it has its own Ranking system and leaderboard
    [*]Since 2V2 is still in BETA version, there’s no season reward
    [*]Same as 3V3, 2V2 rank season will end at Sep. 14th
    [*]2V2 will not open in the Quick Play and Versus A.I. mode
[/list]
[h1]Terran trait ‘Tech Switch’ now change to ‘Elite Troops’[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Now every Terran’s unit can use Tech Switch, the cost is 2% of unit cost for each tech point
    [*]Terran will be more focused on technology, new terran trait: Elite Troops
    [*]You can preset two Terran units to start the game with level 1 on those units, but the cost are increased
    [*]Each unit increase in different cost when set to Elite Troops
    [*]You can’t return the early upgraded tech point by using Tech Switch or Selling back the units
[/list]
[h1]Now the essence mine will upgrade automatically and instantly, no more ‘Upgrade your mine’![/h1]
[list]
    [*]Mine will upgrade automatically in 10/30 waves
    [*]Mine upgrade will not cost any essences 
    [*]Initial Terran/Atlac/Yaoguai’s population cap is 50/40/60, population cap increases 10 for every mine upgrade
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]

What we did to the balance adjustment are based on tremendous match-up data from the game, and analyze the overall improvement relied on player’s feedback. Balance adjustment will be a long-term process, sufficient amount of time is needed to make sure every adjustment is effective and sound reasonable, so please be patient and stay with us, our goal is to provide players with diverse strategies and better game experience. 

About the balance adjustment, since the essence mine system changed, the overall essences production increased, so most units cost increased.

notes.title: Update: New map, 2V2, New Terran Trait, Balance&Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/98f7310fecfc4ef5b66bd98ef72df15141a38b15.jpg[/img]

Hello, Commanders!

New patch is upon us! Featuring a brand new map: Sunset Canyon, new neutral units, exciting 2V2 mode, new Terran trait, and auto-upgrading essence mine. With all that excited contents and changes, more strategies will come into the game and less ‘mouse-clicking’, team up with your friend and head over to Red Tides for real time 2v2 battles! 
The server maintenance will take about 2 hours and be held on:

[b]00:50 PDT August 22[/b]
[b]07:50 GMT August 22[/b]
[b]15:50 GMT+8 August 22[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Map: Sunset Canyon[/h1]
[list]
    [*]In the early game, break the Statues in the middle of battlefield, you will get a population cap for your team
    [*]Statues can be attacked by Anti-air and Anti-ground units
    [*]When the Capsule in the middle of statues is broke by player, it will summon three Shadow Warriors to fight for that player.
    [*]Waves 25, Sarcophagus of Shadows breaks through the surface, then release shadow waves to surrounding, shadow waves cannot damage cloaked units, but will deal massive damage to units that uncloaked. When the Sarcophagus is broke by player, that player will earn some population caps again
    [*]When Sarcophagus of Shadows is broke by player, Belial, the Lord of Shadow appears into the battlefield, 
    [*]Commanders under certain levels cannot encounter this new map
[/list]

[h1]2V2 is available, team up with your friend to take over the battle![/h1]
[list]
    [*]2V2 Ranked mode is opened, it has its own Ranking system and leaderboard
    [*]Since 2V2 is still in BETA version, there’s no season reward
    [*]Same as 3V3, 2V2 rank season will end at Sep. 14th
    [*]2V2 will not open in the Quick Play and Versus A.I. mode
[/list]
[h1]Terran trait ‘Tech Switch’ now change to ‘Elite Troops’[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Now every Terran’s unit can use Tech Switch, the cost is 2% of unit cost for each tech point
    [*]Terran will be more focused on technology, new terran trait: Elite Troops
    [*]You can preset two Terran units to start the game with level 1 on those units, but the cost are increased
    [*]Each unit increase in different cost when set to Elite Troops
    [*]You can’t return the early upgraded tech point by using Tech Switch or Selling back the units
[/list]
[h1]Now the essence mine will upgrade automatically and instantly, no more ‘Upgrade your mine’![/h1]
[list]
    [*]Mine will upgrade automatically in 10/30 waves
    [*]Mine upgrade will not cost any essences 
    [*]Initial Terran/Atlac/Yaoguai’s population cap is 50/40/60, population cap increases 10 for every mine upgrade
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]

What we did to the balance adjustment are based on tremendous match-up data from the game, and analyze the overall improvement relied on player’s feedback. Balance adjustment will be a long-term process, sufficient amount of time is needed to make sure every adjustment is effective and sound reasonable, so please be patient and stay with us, our goal is to provide players with diverse strategies and better game experience. 

About the balance adjustment, since the essence mine system changed, the overall essences production increased, so most units cost increased.

[h1]1. Terran[/h1]

[b]Unit[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/c634b43a2426c3db3a46a6872264c31d45bd8a43.png[/img]

notes.title: Update: New 1V1 Mode, Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6ccf1009f3a0111329ccc367bdfdf6b675366b2.jpg[/img]

We will have a server maintenance to deploy improvements, balance, bug fixes and so on. The maintenance is expected to last 2 hours and will start at:
[b]00:50 PDT August 03[/b]
[b]07:50 GMT August 03[/b]
[b]15:50 GMT+8 August 03[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

[h1]The long-awaited 1v1 Joint Operation is coming![/h1]

This new 1v1 mode is set as an event in Arena, and it adopts a different game mechanics where players can use new strategies.

[b]Introduction:[/b]

1. The Joint Operation will be available as an event in Arena.
2. Players can play one round for free every 5 days. Five victories or two defeats will end this free round.
3. Coins are required to buy tickets for new rounds. Ticket price will increase based on how many rounds a player has attended in 5 days. Ticket will drop to its lowest price at the beginning of the next 7-day period.
4. Players are allowed to choose two formations containing 20 units, and build 6 units from them in battle. Two formations belong to two different races.
5. Then players can choose three commander skills from those two races.

[b]Rules:[/b]

1. Click the “Find Match” button and players will be matched according to their total victories in that round.
2. Battle preparation page is shown as below:

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/c38132253c71ddc518427cb3f3128718c63557d7.jpg[/img]

3. Players can choose two formations they have set in Army Setup. Please note that the two formations should belong to two different races.
4. The population cap will be the average population caps of the two chosen races.
5. The order of different units spawned each wave will be recalculated and rearranged.

[b]Rewards and Leaderboard:[/b]

1. In each round, five victories or 2 defeats will end that round.
2. For each victory, players will be rewarded with coins.
3. For the third and fifth victory, players will be rewarded with bonus supply drops.
4. Core runes that can boost commander skills may be acquired from such supply drops.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/256087f0a0bff75695e8aa4bfd5dd9c705d1c2b2.png[/img] [img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2eba7321370883c1bd6b1d510161f407abc84a7c.png[/img]  [img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2eba7321370883c1bd6b1d510161f407abc84a7c.png[/img]

5. Exclusive skins and avatars may be acquired from such supply drops.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/9951f7666661b5c036e482f15addbeddbbab2cd3.jpg[/img]

6. Added two new achievements:
[list]
    [*]Joint Victory: achieve 5/10/25 victories in Joint Operation. Unlock 3 stars to gain an exclusive avatar.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/29a30448de9d3351225113029f65c8e1dd75b2a9.jpg[/img]

    [*]Winning Streaks: achieve 1/5/10 five-winning-streaks in Joint Operation. Unlock 3 stars to gain an exclusive avatar.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/73349da7a5b763d8f79d52451135128fa121a182.jpg[/img]
[/list]
7. During the Joint Operation event, there will be a new leaderboard displaying players’ rankings based on their total victories in Joint Operation.
8. When in Joint Operation, players can neither unlock the following achievements: Captain General, Whale King, Chieftain, Assassinator, Ninja, Razorclaw, Terran Skill, Atlac Skill and Yaoguai Skill, nor complete daily quests relating to killing units, playing games and winning games.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]

The adjustments on the unit/commander skill/racial trait balance of Art of War: Red Tides are always based on tremendous battle data from players. We also refer to players’ feedback. Such work is a long-lasting process, and we need sufficient time to test so as to guarantee that the adjustments are effective and reasonable. Therefore, commanders, please bear with us our regular balance adjustments, because these work is intended to provide you with more strategies and tactics, as well as better game experience.

[h1]1. Terran[/h1]

[b]Unit[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2de8b3ebe5b6a74f2082596cd85d3ecdb49cd84a.png[/img]
Attack damage decreased from 11 to 8.

[b]Commander Skill[/b]

Anti-Tank Gun
Armor increased from 4 to 6, and HP increased from 400 to 500.

[h1]2. Atlac[/h1]

[b]Unit[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/cc9b34e8cd04c0ad963877d91fa0de718a1a6fe2.png[/img]
Basic attack and active abilities now cannot deal damage to enemy air units.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/526c9407aa1ae0ecf2534699bdbcb8d6cd995f01.png[/img]
Basic attack and active abilities now cannot deal damage to enemy air units.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/492ce3495d5918da94aaf8e82412620d35839b07.png[/img]
Vajra now doesn’t have shield before upgrading.
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.1: Acquires shield and cannot take more than 16 damage from an attack.
Lv.2: Cannot take more than 10 damage from an attack.
Lv.3: Shield increases by 40%.

[b]Commander Skill[/b]

Lightning Tower
Armor increased from 4 to 6, but HP decreased from 600 to 500.

Essence Recycler
Armor increased from 4 to 6.

[h1]3. Yaoguai[/h1]

[b]Unit[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/f4f2cb0769710d3584e0e3f2e0a18d524fa31801.png[/img]
Cost increased from 400 to 500.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/edcfe623eba8612ffd7ce67fc351c5623c7070cb.png[/img]
Attack damage decreased from 20 to 15, armor decreased from 5 to 3, and HP decreased from 150 to 130. Energy consumption of its active ability increased from 10 to 20, healing targets decreased from 3 to 2, and HP restored decreased from 35 to 30. Each time its healing wave passes to the next friendly unit, the HP restored will decrease by 30%.
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.1: Heal max. 3 targets at a time.
Lv.2: HP restored +30%
Lv.3: HP restored +30%, and energy consumption reduced by 10

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/fb80b5680721965b88282dd1d62f66003904d384.jpg[/img]

1. Eyeball, the detector summoned by the Gazer will now count as 1 population among the 120 population cap on the battlefield. Once the 120 population cap is reached, players cannot add more units unless the total population drops.
2. The fire spit by the Dragon of Soul Essence now only deals damage to ground units.
3. The Dragon Cub’s attack speed decreased from 1.6s to 2s.
4. The bombs dropped by the Mechanohound now can inflict damage on both ground and air units at the target location.
5. When the Mechanohound starts to aid a team, it now only launches missiles to attack. Its attack speed increased from 5s to 2.5s.
6. The cost of Tech Switch decreased from 5% per unit to 1% per unit.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/dffb4167be1699bc4d335d6ee452ae82b5e0aa74.jpg[/img]

1. Fixed the bug of the Restoration Deer not healing friendly units when there is no mechanical unit on the battlefield.
2. The Restoration Deer now doesn’t heal buildings.
3. The Medivac now doesn’t heal mechanical units.
4. Now if a player hasn’t reached commander level 15, s/he won’t be assigned daily quests relating to ranked games.
5. Fixed the bug of the Iron Maiden dealing damage to units outside its attack range after it crashes.
6. Fixed the incorrect friend online status.
7. Fixed the mismatch between commander skill names and icons in battle.
8. Fixed the occasional mismatch between commander names and avatars when players chat, use commander skills or send emotes.
9. Fixed the Lightning Tower’s attack not showing special effect.
10. Fixed the incorrect look of summoned units/buildings’ HP bar.

Commanders, thanks for your support. The faster you can offer feedback, the quicker we can respond to bugs and problems. We will continue to collect your opinions and advice, so again, please don’t hesitate to share them with us below!

See you on the battlefield,
The Art of War: Red Tides Team

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

[h1]The long-awaited 1v1 Joint Operation is coming![/h1]

This new 1v1 mode is set as an event in Arena, and it adopts a different game mechanics where players can use new strategies.

[b]Introduction:[/b]

1. The Joint Operation will be available as an event in Arena.
2. Players can play one round for free every 5 days. Five victories or two defeats will end this free round.
3. Coins are required to buy tickets for new rounds. Ticket price will increase based on how many rounds a player has attended in 5 days. Ticket will drop to its lowest price at the beginning of the next 7-day period.
4. Players are allowed to choose two formations containing 20 units, and build 6 units from them in battle. Two formations belong to two different races.
5. Then players can choose three commander skills from those two races.

[b]Rules:[/b]

1. Click the “Find Match” button and players will be matched according to their total victories in that round.
2. Battle preparation page is shown as below:

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/c38132253c71ddc518427cb3f3128718c63557d7.jpg[/img]

3. Players can choose two formations they have set in Army Setup. Please note that the two formations should belong to two different races.
4. The population cap will be the average population caps of the two chosen races.
5. The order of different units spawned each wave will be recalculated and rearranged.

[b]Rewards and Leaderboard:[/b]

1. In each round, five victories or 2 defeats will end that round.
2. For each victory, players will be rewarded with coins.
3. For the third and fifth victory, players will be rewarded with bonus supply drops.
4. Core runes that can boost commander skills may be acquired from such supply drops.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/256087f0a0bff75695e8aa4bfd5dd9c705d1c2b2.png[/img] [img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2eba7321370883c1bd6b1d510161f407abc84a7c.png[/img]  [img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2eba7321370883c1bd6b1d510161f407abc84a7c.png[/img]

5. Exclusive skins and avatars may be acquired from such supply drops.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/9951f7666661b5c036e482f15addbeddbbab2cd3.jpg[/img]

6. Added two new achievements:
[list]
    [*]Joint Victory: achieve 5/10/25 victories in Joint Operation. Unlock 3 stars to gain an exclusive avatar.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/29a30448de9d3351225113029f65c8e1dd75b2a9.jpg[/img]

    [*]Winning Streaks: achieve 1/5/10 five-winning-streaks in Joint Operation. Unlock 3 stars to gain an exclusive avatar.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/73349da7a5b763d8f79d52451135128fa121a182.jpg[/img]
[/list]
7. During the Joint Operation event, there will be a new leaderboard displaying players’ rankings based on their total victories in Joint Operation.
8. When in Joint Operation, players can neither unlock the following achievements: Captain General, Whale King, Chieftain, Assassinator, Ninja, Razorclaw, Terran Skill, Atlac Skill and Yaoguai Skill, nor complete daily quests relating to killing units, playing games and winning games.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]

The adjustments on the unit/commander skill/racial trait balance of Art of War: Red Tides are always based on tremendous battle data from players. We also refer to players’ feedback. Such work is a long-lasting process, and we need sufficient time to test so as to guarantee that the adjustments are effective and reasonable. Therefore, commanders, please bear with us our regular balance adjustments, because these work is intended to provide you with more strategies and tactics, as well as better game experience.

[h1]1. Terran[/h1]

[b]Unit[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2de8b3ebe5b6a74f2082596cd85d3ecdb49cd84a.png[/img]
Attack damage decreased from 11 to 8.

[b]Commander Skill[/b]

Anti-Tank Gun
Armor increased from 4 to 6, and HP increased from 400 to 500.

[h1]2. Atlac[/h1]

[b]Unit[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/cc9b34e8cd04c0ad963877d91fa0de718a1a6fe2.png[/img]
Basic attack and active abilities now cannot deal damage to enemy air units.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/526c9407aa1ae0ecf2534699bdbcb8d6cd995f01.png[/img]
Basic attack and active abilities now cannot deal damage to enemy air units.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/492ce3495d5918da94aaf8e82412620d35839b07.png[/img]
Vajra now doesn’t have shield before upgrading.
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.1: Acquires shield and cannot take more than 16 damage from an attack.
Lv.2: Cannot take more than 10 damage from an attack.
Lv.3: Shield increases by 40%.

[b]Commander Skill[/b]

Lightning Tower
Armor increased from 4 to 6, but HP decreased from 600 to 500.

Essence Recycler
Armor increased from 4 to 6.

[h1]3. Yaoguai[/h1]

[b]Unit[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/f4f2cb0769710d3584e0e3f2e0a18d524fa31801.png[/img]
Cost increased from 400 to 500.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/edcfe623eba8612ffd7ce67fc351c5623c7070cb.png[/img]
Attack damage decreased from 20 to 15, armor decreased from 5 to 3, and HP decreased from 150 to 130. Energy consumption of its active ability increased from 10 to 20, healing targets decreased from 3 to 2, and HP restored decreased from 35 to 30. Each time its healing wave passes to the next friendly unit, the HP restored will decrease by 30%.
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.1: Heal max. 3 targets at a time.
Lv.2: HP restored +30%
Lv.3: HP restored +30%, and energy consumption reduced by 10

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/fb80b5680721965b88282dd1d62f66003904d384.jpg[/img]

1. Eyeball, the detector summoned by the Gazer will now count as 1 population among the 120 population cap on the battlefield. Once the 120 population cap is reached, players cannot add more units unless the total population drops.
2. The fire spit by the Dragon of Soul Essence now only deals damage to ground units.
3. The Dragon Cub’s attack speed decreased from 1.6s to 2s.
4. The bombs dropped by the Mechanohound now can inflict damage on both ground and air units at the target location.
5. When the Mechanohound starts to aid a team, it now only launches missiles to attack. Its attack speed increased from 5s to 2.5s.
6. The cost of Tech Switch decreased from 5% per unit to 1% per unit.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/dffb4167be1699bc4d335d6ee452ae82b5e0aa74.jpg[/img]

1. Fixed the bug of the Restoration Deer not healing friendly units when there is no mechanical unit on the battlefield.
2. The Restoration Deer now doesn’t heal buildings.
3. The Medivac now doesn’t heal mechanical units.
4. Now if a player hasn’t reached commander level 15, s/he won’t be assigned daily quests relating to ranked games.
5. Fixed the bug of the Iron Maiden dealing damage to units outside its attack range after it crashes.
6. Fixed the incorrect friend online status.
7. Fixed the mismatch between commander skill names and icons in battle.
8. Fixed the occasional mismatch between commander names and avatars when players chat, use commander skills or send emotes.
9. Fixed the Lightning Tower’s attack not showing special effect.
10. Fixed the incorrect look of summoned units/buildings’ HP bar.

Commanders, thanks for your support. The faster you can offer feedback, the quicker we can respond to bugs and problems. We will continue to collect your opinions and advice, so again, please don’t hesitate to share them with us below!

See you on the battlefield,
The Art of War: Red Tides Team

notes.title: Update: Improvements, Balance and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/51ee9686200a0b556dc2880ef6bc4d2f2fda98dd.jpg[/img]

We will have a server maintenance to deploy improvements, balance, bug fixes and so on. The maintenance is expected to last 2 hours and will start at:

[b]00:50 PDT July 20[/b]
[b]07:50 GMT July 20[/b]
[b]15:50 GMT+8 July 20[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

[h1]1. Season Zero[/h1]

The long-awaited Season Zero will start after this update!
[list]
    [*]Season Zero will start after the weekly update on July 20th and end before the weekly update on September 14th.
    [*] player records/history relating to ranks and tiers in the Preseason will be cleared. Commanders need to start from scratch on a new Leaderboard.
    [*]Commanders achieved at least Platinum will be awarded with special avatars representing the highest tier they achieved in the Season Zero.
    [*]Commanders achieved at least Gold will be awarded with Blessed Survivor, the limited edition skin for the Storm Hierophant.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/8070f0cfd6a875ff97591f74c5f8a14f23208600.jpg[/img]
    [*]Commanders will get one of the following rewards according to the highest tier they achieved in the Season Zero:
[list]
    [*]300 gems for Bronze
    [*]500 gems for Silver
    [*]1000 gems and Blessed Survivor, the limited edition skin for the Storm Hierophant, for Gold
    [*]1500 gems, the limited edition skin Blessed Survivor and the honorable avatar Platinum General for Platinum
    [*]2000 gems, the limited edition skin Blessed Survivor and the honorable avatar Diamond General for Diamond
    [*]3000 gems, the limited edition skin Blessed Survivor and the honorable avatar Supreme Commander for Supreme Commander
[/list]
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/179ca861473daec848b98638bb7e4e2154a165c6.gif[/img]　　[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/5a5e3cb6b7c16917aa6647ff6d95e75e51fc4483.gif[/img]　　[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a20f0d6af46dd2b90c72afe0f4d9059cfcdbd6e9.gif[/img]

All the rewards will be sent to commanders’ in-game inbox after Season Zero ends.

[h1]2. New Terran Trait to Replace Mass Production[/h1]

Mass Production will be replaced by Tech Switch, a new Terran trait which returns the consumed tech points to degrade units at the expanse of some soul essence.
[list]
    [*]Players can set units for Tech Switch in Army Setup.
    [*]The set units can be degraded at the expanse of some soul essence.
    [*]The soul essence spent = total number of the unit to be degraded*the cost of this unit*total tech points to be returned after degrading*5%
    [*]Players press the Confirm button on a unit’s Tech Switch screen and the soul essence will be immediately spent. The whole process lasts 18 seconds. During the process, this unit cannot be degraded again or upgraded.
    [*]Tech points won’t be returned until the Tech Switch completes.
    [*]During the Tech Switch, this unit will retain level if respawned. If players add/reduce the number of this unit in the process, Tech Switch will still continue. If players remove this unit from the troop in the process, they won’t be refunded with the soul essence spent on Tech Switch, but the tech points will be returned.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]

The adjustments on the unit/commander skill/racial trait balance of Art of War: Red Tides are always based on tremendous battle data from players. We also refer to players’ feedback. Such work is a long-lasting process, and we need sufficient time to test so as to guarantee that the adjustments are effective and reasonable. Therefore, commanders, please bear with us our regular balance adjustments, because these work is intended to provide you with more strategies and tactics, as well as better game experience.

[h1]1. Terran[/h1]

[b]Unit[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/f832f631d4dfd224a72813c8f8c3f64f399801a3.png[/img]
Attack damage increased from 8 to 10.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/058fe5c15ec87d1d89e9503195f0fd33187173c8.png[/img]
Attack damage decreased from 10 to 8.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/4f4d5d644b5431a1ed8fa7ae126100e535a9b64b.png[/img]
Ability Shield Bash now can be acquired by upgrade.
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.1: Damage reflection of the Thornpavise increased to 10
Lv.2: Basic attack turns to Shield Bash. Inflict 20 damage to 3 nearby enemies.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/18d55c84c059832fc87fcb00961eecae0252ad73.png[/img]
Attack range decreased from 12 to 10.
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.1: Attack range increased to 15
Lv.2: Inflict 250% damage to biological units
Lv.3: Attack damage +20%

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/ab3b07bacf8db8c60dfa4ec04378396f727e00e8.png[/img]
The radius of the sector to which it inflicts damage increased from 12 to 16.
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.1: Each attack inflicts damage to up to 3 enemies
Lv.2: Each attack deals bonus damage once to max. 3 ground enemies within a 180°and 6 radius sector

[h1]2. Atlac[/h1]

[b]Unit[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/c4ca462979fc6138da13ceb52bfbb1ac041873c0.png[/img]
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.1: Blade Dash temporarily grants her 10 armor
Lv.2: Blade Dash temporarily grants her 20 armor
Lv.3: Basic attack becomes Heavy Slash. Deal 10 damage respectively to max. 3 nearby enemies

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/cc9b34e8cd04c0ad963877d91fa0de718a1a6fe2.png[/img]
The radius of its Thunder Orb’s affected area increased from 20 to 35.

[h1]3. Yaoguai[/h1]

[b]Unit[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/12e5afd842693780b3a195a14de73cafa11abda9.png[/img]
Attack range increased from 14 to 17, and attack speed increased from 2.4s to 1.8s.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/e601bc62e770c00c49f62bf6587e73555ebee35c.png[/img]
Armor reduced from 4 to 3.
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.3: Inflict 250% damage to mechanical units

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/f98e40dfe8226cb074ddf75c907a7d1ffda69255.png[/img]
Cost increased from 1200 to 1400.

[b]Commander Skill[/b]

Shrink
Now it can shrink the Lightning Tower and the Anti-Tank Gun.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/fb80b5680721965b88282dd1d62f66003904d384.jpg[/img]

1. The ranged damage reduction of the Mechanohound decreased from 45 to 30. After the Mechanohound starts to aid the team who defeated it, its ranged damage reduction is decreased from 30 to 20.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/dffb4167be1699bc4d335d6ee452ae82b5e0aa74.jpg[/img]

1. Fixed the occasional bug of the Savage Whale not attacking the enemy base.
2. Fixed the bug of some players being unable to acquire Yaoguai Commander Skill Ancient Egg.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2b3fdb984957767a46729c992bd81bc19fd200a0.jpg[/img]

1. In final battle when both sides are unable to respawn units, the XP for tech points now won’t be increased anymore.
2. Further optimized the validation method and punishment for AFKers.
3. Optimized the unit description in tooltips:
[list]
    [*]Added brief upgrade introduction to units in tooltips
    [*]Adjusted the description on unit ability for the following units: Terran A-76 Mortus, Q-50 Dauntless, Atlac Lightning Arhat, Yaoguai Silklash Spider, Shuriken Panda, Panda Monk, Chan Master and Restoration Deer. Instead of a general summary, the description now focuses on their single attack damage.
    [*]Removed the “Area Damage” tag for Terran Medivac, Yaoguai Kamikaze Beetle, Panda Monk and Restoration Deer.
    [*]Added the “Area Damage” tag for Terran Shotgun Motorcycle, Atlac Shield Slave, Silver Shield Slave, Sawblade Shield Slave, Lightning Ray, Lightning Arhat, Yaoguai Fiery Minotaur and Raging Minotaur.
    [*]Added the “Strong against: mechanical” tag for the Marauder.
    [*]Added “…restore HP for up to 3 ground biological units…” in the Medivac’s unit description.
    [*]Added “…inflicts 250% damage to biological units” in the Shadow Bat’s ability description.
    [*]Optimized some unit description in tooltips.
[/list]	
4. Withdrawal now can withdraw units directed by False Rally.
5. Now the tier stars will be fully filled if a player who can be promoted to a higher tier with one more star achieves a victory, but the tier won’t be promoted automatically. Also, if a player has a one-star tier and loses a match, s/he will lose that star instead of being demoted to a lower tier. But if the player has no stars at his/her current tier, s/he will be demoted to a lower tier.

Commanders, thanks for your support. The faster you can offer feedback, the quicker we can respond to various bugs and problems. We will continue to collect your opinions and advice, so again, please don’t hesitate to share them with us below!

See you on the battlefield,
The Art of War: Red Tides Team

    [*]The gold is now rewarded to the team who destroyed the turret.

Units passed the mist will get a buff: after they are destroyed, the commander who produced these units will get a refund of some soul essence. The refund is now decreased from 5% to 3% of those dead units’ total cost.

[olist]
    [*]Further optimized matchmaking to guarantee that players can battle against other players of the similar level in a shorter time.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/27b79fee264b6f8daeec8ecc42738ae3434da020.jpg[/img]

Steam Trading Cards for Art of War: Red Tides will be online in 7 days.
Commanders can get trading cards by playing the game. Collect a set of cards to craft a Red Tides badge, and get an emoticon item created for the game (can use in chat or discussions) and a profile background item created for the game (can use on players’ Steam Community profile).

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/6010d1ff0016e75d82d2dc71e0d5cb5887b17ea0.jpg[/img]

Commanders, thanks for your support. The faster you can offer feedback, the quicker we can respond to various bugs and problems. We will continue to collect your opinions and advice, so again, please don’t hesitate to share them with us below!

See you on the battlefield,
The Art of War: Red Tides Team

notes.title: Update: Improvements, New Neutral Units, Balance & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/5ff3758cb37f54c8a142bb3011081161e3645e7c.jpg[/img]
We will have a server maintenance to deploy improvements, balance, bug fixes and so on. The maintenance is expected to last 2 hours, and starts at:

[b]01:00 PDT July 06[/b]
[b]08:00 GMT July 06[/b]
[b]16:00 GMT+8 July 06[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

The key improvements this time are related to the changes in battle mechanics, including new neutral units and resource acquisition. Unit balance, Mass Production as well as other critical adjustments and improvements are also in our plan.

The improvements serve for the following design goals:
[list]
[*]Enable smarter play and encourage more changeable strategies in the battle.
[*]Commander who did perform much better than others in a battle should get bonus reward.
[/list]
It is unavoidable that these improvements and adjustments will cause some influence to you. So, to give you time to familiarize yourselves with the new mechanics, the Season Zero which is supposed to start on July 6th will be postponed to July 20th or an even later date.

We will always keep a close eye on how these improvements work, and implement further adjustments at any time if necessary. Again, we are grateful for your support!

[h1]New Neutral Unit[/h1]

[b]1. The Forest of Soul Essence: Dragon[/b]
[list]
[*]The soul essence crates in wave 1 will be replaced by the soul essence eggs laid by the dragon. Destroy them and you will still be rewarded with soul essence.
[*]After the larger egg in the center is broken, a dragon cub will get out from it to assist the player who broke the egg. It has 70 attack damage and 28 attack range.
[*]The Dragon of Soul Essence flying to the battlefield in wave 25 is an air unit, thus can only be affected by anti-air attacks.
[*]For each attack the Dragon of Soul Essence takes, the attacker(s) will be rewarded with some soul essence based on the HP the Dragon is reduced. After it dies, all teammates of the team who killed the Dragon of Soul Essence will be rewarded with a large amount of soul essence.
[*]After the Dragon of Soul Essence dies, its body will generates a cloud of mist around it. Units passing the mist will get a buff: after they are destroyed, the commander who produced these units will get a refund of some soul essence.
[/list]
[b]2. Black Mine: Mechanohound[/b]
[list]
[*]Destroy the neutral crates in the early stage and you and your teammates will be rewarded with gold.
[*]The crates float in the air and can only be affected by anti-air attacks.
[*]The neutral unit comes to the battlefield in wave 25 is a Mechanohound. It can largely reduce the ranged damage on it, and won’t be targeted by anti-air attacks. Ground melee units are recommended.
[*]For each attack the Mechanohound takes, the attacker(s) will be rewarded with some gold based on the HP the Mechanohound is reduced. After it dies, all teammates of the team who killed the Mechanohound will be rewarded with a large amount of gold.
[*]After being killed, the Mechanohound will come to life again to assist the team who killed it.
[*]We are still testing the difficulty of this new unit. Commanders below a certain level may have no access to this map.
[/list]
[h1]Adjustments[/h1]

[b]1. XP and tech point[/b]
[list]
[*]You can acquire up to 12 tech points instead of 10.
[*]Kill any neutral unit and the killer will be rewarded with bonus XP.
[*]Changed the XP needed for each tech point for a gentle upgrading curve.
[*]Added special effect for the tech point ring at the bottom of the battle screen when players acquired a lot of XP at a time.
[/list]
[b]2. Notifications in battle[/b]
[list]	
[*]Raised the amount of rewarded soul essence after players routed/annihilated/smashed/conquered/revenged the enemy troops.
[*]After a player manages to destroy a wave of enemy troops, s/he will acquire bonus XP whose amount is positively correlated with the total cost of the enemy troops s/he killed.
[*]If the troops survive more than 54 seconds, though they are then annihilated by a player, the player won’t receive killing notification nor any reward.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]

[h1]Terrans[/h1]

[b]Units[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/9cd4039235bdd60418d3690e23c92dcaca6dc670.png[/img]
HP increased from 200 to 220, attack speed increased from 1.4s to 1.2s, the range of the energy beam increased from 22 to 24, and the description of Particle Cannon changed from “…4 energy beams…dealing 20 damage” to “…2 energy beams…dealing 40 damage”; before upgrade, the plasma it spits can attack the target with more enemy units around.
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.2: Active ability deals 250% damage to biological units

[b]Commander Skill[/b]

Flare
“…reduce the attack damage of all units in the target area by 5” changed to “…reduce the attack damage of all units in the target area by 30%”.

[h1]Atlac[/h1]

[b]Units[/b]	

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/28f5ea8ef8265e9e32f7c65f40c638515c161474.png[/img]
Attack range increased from 6 to 8, and attack speed increased from 1.6s to 1.2s.
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.1: Attack range increased to 10
Lv.2: Lightning bounces 4 times, attacking a single target each time
Lv.3: Attack damage +20%

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/cac0ec9292be03b6fc8c6090660dad7828ad661e.png[/img]
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.1: Attack damage +10%
Lv.2: Max. shield +100%
Lv.3: Damage to mechanical units increased to 250%

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/142321a2be354e2fdd5b471ce1b041421d9a841f.png[/img]
HP increased from 100 to 140

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/560735815e1db238239e9c982a728e04a966d44a.png[/img]
Maximum damage on ground units decreased from 215 to 155

[h1]Yaoguai[/h1]

[b]Units[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/e925c0f5787f19126244f0147aa0953096c28076.png[/img]
HP decreased from 40 to 35, attack damage decreased from 15 to 14, and attack speed decreased from 1s to 1.3s.
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.2: Attack speed +30%

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/3970ea4fa53e0a8278c40cf7bba1162ceea6825d.png[/img]
HP decreased from 90 to 80, and it no longer deals 125% damage to biological units.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/d184225b97cbe36d94c25ac741dcfaf00f09a74e.png[/img]
Chi Orb cannot attack air units.
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.2: Chi Orb's damage increased by 20% and attack range enlarged
Lv.3: Chi Orb still exists after the Chan Master dies

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/f5661fddbe0be622fe467ee8d26dd008c345178e.png[/img]
Friendly units upon its blanket will have their attack damage increased by 5% per second. Such increase can overlay up to 10s. After they leave the blanket, the effect will last as long as 10s.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/e36c29d2f4e2246faefadc37943afd98e0ce9f1c.png[/img]
Armor decreased from 10 to 8. It can no longer deal extra damage to mechanical units.
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.1: Armor +25%
Lv.2: Max. HP +15%
Lv.3: Deal 250% damage to mechanical units

[b]Commander Skill[/b]

Sacrifice
Sacrifice now can only be released within the revealed area.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/fb80b5680721965b88282dd1d62f66003904d384.jpg[/img]
[olist]
[*]Changed the mining rate of the soul essence mine in different levels respectively from 25/s, 50/s and 100/s to 25/s, 40/s and 80/s.
[*]Players can now acquire 100% gold if they killed enemy units survived longer than 30s.
[*]Unit A.I.
[olist]
[*]The Yaoguai unit Bloodfeather’s Descend to the Ground now can be activated even there’s no enemy air units (only enemy ground units) on the battlefield.
[*]Melee units such as the Regular Paviser, the Regular Flamethrower, the HEF Flamethrower, the Shield Slave and the Sawblade Shield Slave will attack the direction with most enemy units around to improve attack efficiency.
[*]The Medic, the Medivac, the Maintenance Engineer and other units alike will first heal units being attacked, and they will choose their targets smarter.
[*]The Asterion, the Bowcat and other units alike will attack enemy air units first.
[/olist]
[/olist]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/dffb4167be1699bc4d335d6ee452ae82b5e0aa74.jpg[/img]
[olist]
[*]Fixed the occasional game crash caused by players’ changing avatars.
[*]Fixed the occasional game crash caused by players’ purchasing eternium ingots in store.
[*]Fixed the bug of players still being able to send friend requests when the number of friends reached maximum.
[*]Fixed the bug of the Atlac Commander Skill Essence Recycler being unable to collect extra soul essence from the dead units.
[*]Fixed the bug of being unable to switch to Ranked 1V1 mode after being refused by friend(s) on Ranked 3V3 invitation.
[*]Fixed the bug of the Atlac Lightning Ray’s attack not inflicting damage.
[*]Corrected the description of the Yaoguai unit Blazefury Deer’s ability. It can actually deal 200% damage to buildings.
[/olist]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2b3fdb984957767a46729c992bd81bc19fd200a0.jpg[/img]
[olist]
[*]Players can directly check the kills of a team or an individual commander in battle screen.
[*]Players can press Tab button to check the total soul essence they acquire from kills.
[*]Optimized matchmaking so that players are more likely to be matched with opponents of the similar level.
[*]Optimized verification methods on AFKers. The verification methods and rules will be stricter and more reasonable.
[/olist]
Commanders, thanks for your support. The faster you can offer feedback, the quicker we can respond to various bugs and problems. We will continue to collect your opinions and advice, so again, please don’t hesitate to share them with us below!

See you on the battlefield,
The Art of War: Red Tides Team

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a6cb0ffb959f43e5c6a1c51ef411fa64eba6e27f.jpg[/img]

The key improvements this time are related to the changes in battle mechanics, including new neutral units and resource acquisition. Unit balance, Mass Production as well as other critical adjustments and improvements are also in our plan.

The improvements serve for the following design goals:
[list]
[*]Enable smarter play and encourage more changeable strategies in the battle.
[*]Commander who did perform much better than others in a battle should get bonus reward.
[/list]
It is unavoidable that these improvements and adjustments will cause some influence to you. So, to give you time to familiarize yourselves with the new mechanics, the Season Zero which is supposed to start on July 6th will be postponed to July 20th or an even later date.

We will always keep a close eye on how these improvements work, and implement further adjustments at any time if necessary. Again, we are grateful for your support!

[h1]New Neutral Unit[/h1]

[b]1. The Forest of Soul Essence: Dragon[/b]
[list]
[*]The soul essence crates in wave 1 will be replaced by the soul essence eggs laid by the dragon. Destroy them and you will still be rewarded with soul essence.
[*]After the larger egg in the center is broken, a dragon cub will get out from it to assist the player who broke the egg. It has 70 attack damage and 28 attack range.
[*]The Dragon of Soul Essence flying to the battlefield in wave 25 is an air unit, thus can only be affected by anti-air attacks.
[*]For each attack the Dragon of Soul Essence takes, the attacker(s) will be rewarded with some soul essence based on the HP the Dragon is reduced. After it dies, all teammates of the team who killed the Dragon of Soul Essence will be rewarded with a large amount of soul essence.
[*]After the Dragon of Soul Essence dies, its body will generates a cloud of mist around it. Units passing the mist will get a buff: after they are destroyed, the commander who produced these units will get a refund of some soul essence.
[/list]
[b]2. Black Mine: Mechanohound[/b]
[list]
[*]Destroy the neutral crates in the early stage and you and your teammates will be rewarded with gold.
[*]The crates float in the air and can only be affected by anti-air attacks.
[*]The neutral unit comes to the battlefield in wave 25 is a Mechanohound. It can largely reduce the ranged damage on it, and won’t be targeted by anti-air attacks. Ground melee units are recommended.
[*]For each attack the Mechanohound takes, the attacker(s) will be rewarded with some gold based on the HP the Mechanohound is reduced. After it dies, all teammates of the team who killed the Mechanohound will be rewarded with a large amount of gold.
[*]After being killed, the Mechanohound will come to life again to assist the team who killed it.
[*]We are still testing the difficulty of this new unit. Commanders below a certain level may have no access to this map.
[/list]
[h1]Adjustments[/h1]

[b]1. XP and tech point[/b]
[list]
[*]You can acquire up to 12 tech points instead of 10.
[*]Kill any neutral unit and the killer will be rewarded with bonus XP.
[*]Changed the XP needed for each tech point for a gentle upgrading curve.
[*]Added special effect for the tech point ring at the bottom of the battle screen when players acquired a lot of XP at a time.
[/list]
[b]2. Notifications in battle[/b]
[list]	
[*]Raised the amount of rewarded soul essence after players routed/annihilated/smashed/conquered/revenged the enemy troops.
[*]After a player manages to destroy a wave of enemy troops, s/he will acquire bonus XP whose amount is positively correlated with the total cost of the enemy troops s/he killed.
[*]If the troops survive more than 54 seconds, though they are then annihilated by a player, the player won’t receive killing notification nor any reward.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]

[b]Units[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/9cd4039235bdd60418d3690e23c92dcaca6dc670.png[/img]

Flare

[h1]Atlac[/h1]

Attack range increased from 6 to 8, and attack speed increased from 1.6s to 1.2s.

Lv.2: Lightning bounces 4 times, attacking a single target each time
Lv.3: Attack damage +20%

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/cac0ec9292be03b6fc8c6090660dad7828ad661e.png[/img]
Upgrade Adjustments:

Lv.2: Max. shield +100%

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/142321a2be354e2fdd5b471ce1b041421d9a841f.png[/img]
HP increased from 100 to 140

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/560735815e1db238239e9c982a728e04a966d44a.png[/img]
Maximum damage on ground units decreased from 215 to 155

[h1]Yaoguai[/h1]

[b]Units[/b]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/e925c0f5787f19126244f0147aa0953096c28076.png[/img]
HP decreased from 40 to 35, attack damage decreased from 15 to 14, and attack speed decreased from 1s to 1.3s.
Upgrade Adjustments:
Lv.2: Attack speed +30%

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/3970ea4fa53e0a8278c40cf7bba1162ceea6825d.png[/img]
HP decreased from 90 to 80, and it no longer deals 125% damage to biological units.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/d184225b97cbe36d94c25ac741dcfaf00f09a74e.png[/img]
Chi Orb cannot attack air units.

Friendly units upon its blanket will have their attack damage increased by 5% per second. Such increase can overlay up to 10s. After they leave the blanket, the effect will last as long as 10s.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/e36c29d2f4e2246faefadc37943afd98e0ce9f1c.png[/img]
Armor decreased from 10 to 8. It can no longer deal extra damage to mechanical units.
Upgrade Adjustments:

[b]Commander Skill[/b]

Sacrifice
Sacrifice now can only be released within the revealed area.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/fb80b5680721965b88282dd1d62f66003904d384.jpg[/img]
[olist]
[*]Changed the mining rate of the soul essence mine in different levels respectively from 25/s, 50/s and 100/s to 25/s, 40/s and 80/s.
[*]Players can now acquire 100% gold if they killed enemy units survived longer than 30s.
[*]Unit A.I.
[olist]
[*]The Yaoguai unit Bloodfeather’s Descend to the Ground now can be activated even there’s no enemy air units (only enemy ground units) on the battlefield.
[*]Melee units such as the Regular Paviser, the Regular Flamethrower, the HEF Flamethrower, the Shield Slave and the Sawblade Shield Slave will attack the direction with most enemy units around to improve attack efficiency.
[*]The Medic, the Medivac, the Maintenance Engineer and other units alike will first heal units being attacked, and they will choose their targets smarter.
[*]The Asterion, the Bowcat and other units alike will attack enemy air units first.
[/olist]
[/olist]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/dffb4167be1699bc4d335d6ee452ae82b5e0aa74.jpg[/img]
[olist]
[*]Fixed the occasional game crash caused by players’ changing avatars.
[*]Fixed the occasional game crash caused by players’ purchasing eternium ingots in store.
[*]Fixed the bug of players still being able to send friend requests when the number of friends reached maximum.
[*]Fixed the bug of the Atlac Commander Skill Essence Recycler being unable to collect extra soul essence from the dead units.
[*]Fixed the bug of being unable to switch to Ranked 1V1 mode after being refused by friend(s) on Ranked 3V3 invitation.
[*]Fixed the bug of the Atlac Lightning Ray’s attack not inflicting damage.
[*]Corrected the description of the Yaoguai unit Blazefury Deer’s ability. It can actually deal 200% damage to buildings.
[/olist]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/2b3fdb984957767a46729c992bd81bc19fd200a0.jpg[/img]
[olist]
[*]Players can directly check the kills of a team or an individual commander in battle screen.
[*]Players can press Tab button to check the total soul essence they acquire from kills.
[*]Optimized matchmaking so that players are more likely to be matched with opponents of the similar level.
[*]Optimized verification methods on AFKers. The verification methods and rules will be stricter and more reasonable.
[/olist]
Commanders, thanks for your support. The faster you can offer feedback, the quicker we can respond to various bugs and problems. We will continue to collect your opinions and advice, so again, please don’t hesitate to share them with us below!

See you on the battlefield,
The Art of War: Red Tides Team

notes.title: Commanders,You deserve a better Season Zero
notes.content:
During the preseason, our designers and developers have been competing with you commanders every day, overwhelming the new comers or being whipped by pros. Overall, much of us have achieved above Lv100. On the other hand, however, we feel more urgently to improve Art of War: Red Tides.

Since the Art of War: Red Tides is a strategy game, our dev team has been always keeping a close eye on its difficulty. To be frank, we don’t think that the current unit/Commander Skill balance and variety are good enough, for instance,
[list]
    [*]There’s barely a change in strategy in a single battle, and players usually go with the same old strategy.
    [*]In 3V3 battles, three teammates are always rewarded the same amount of soul essence/tech points regardless of their performance, which makes pro players’ largely depend on their teammates and unable to lead the team.
    [*]1V1 mode intensified the imbalance in unit and race, making the overwhelmed player even weaker.
    [*]There are too many units that seldom show on the battlefield compared to the total unit number, and each race has this or that shortcomings. A lot of units’ battle performance hasn’t lived up to our expectation.
    [*]As for race traits, Mass Production is not very useful compared to Immolation.
[/list]
So based on your feedback, our data analysis and our own game experience, our dev team will deploy some adjustments and improvements in terms of game mechanics in the update scheduled for July 6th. Therefore, Season Zero which should start on July 6th will be postponed by two weeks and start on July 20th, for the following reasons：
[list]
    [*]Give you some time to familiarize yourselves with new game mechanics and balance.
    [*]Give the dev team more time to see if the adjustments and improvements work.
[/list]
We will share with you the details of the adjustments and improvements, as well as our design philosophy and the future direction of our game.

Commander, we sincerely ask you to join us in this expedition to the future full of uncertainties!

Art of War: Red Tides Team

notes.title: Update: New Units, Balance, Improvements & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/22a97ce858f504efdb6370e9e16f372721ecf405.jpg[/img]

We will have a server maintenance to deploy bug fixes, new units, improvements and so on. The maintenance is expected to last for 2 hours, and starts at:

01:00 PDT June 22
08:00 GMT June 22
16:00 GMT+8 June 22

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/22845afe0bb3d91a718a475478f3e4c77a15ef20.jpg[/img]

[b]Jump Jet Infantry[/b]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/cf658cae1a0629d6e14ccb7c802b303ec5e53909.gif[/img]

As the cheapest unit with active ability, the Jump Jet Infantry will go up in the air after being activated, and attack enemy ground units. He attacks from the air in early game. So take care of your Kamikaze pets, commanders!

[b]Multirole Motorcycle[/b]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/16848b11dab6fbd3f5eadb0b6b85a8fad1933453.gif[/img]

The Multirole Motorcycle is excellent at anti-air & ground. After being upgraded, his true damage can overwhelm some front-row units.

[b]Iron Guardian[/b]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/9ec481c1dccdf8b6da883a942c80cd625abfa7fb.gif[/img]

He is stronger against the air force, and has higher attack damage compared with the Silver Guardian, making the Iron Guardian the air defense of the best cost performance in early game.

[b]Sawblade Shield Slave[/b]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/d25eb5146f477f24bf0dd549c90033a7015e1ff0.gif[/img]

With the Sawblade Shield Slaves, countering units spam is never a problem. Units of low armor won’t stand a single blow. The Sawblade Shield Slave himself has higher HP and armor, thus can survive much longer on the battlefield. Even if they are confronting enemy force with high armor, Sawblade Shield Slaves can smash them when coordinating with Commander Skills.

[b]Chan Master[/b]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/23b458d4bf49c2b937b2633c1ba616054c2bc0a2.gif[/img]

The Panda returns! It is still the Master you are familiar with. Besides, the Chi Orb it generates will inflict AOE damage to enemy’s both air and ground units on the path.

[b]Raging Minotaur[/b]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/a1af386c883e75d6d0fd66f980166d184ef7c5b7.gif[/img]

The Yaoguai gets another meat shield! As the Raging Minotaur won’t be impacted too much by the ranged attack, it can charge into the enemy troop to launch attack. As long as its shield is crushed, the Raging Minotaur will fall into fury.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/eba1566ad780465a94ad12e71c10c57f2dce6407.jpg[/img]

The adjustments on the balance of Art of War: Red Tides are always based on tremendous battle data from players. We also refer to players’ feedback. Such work is a long-lasting process, and needs sufficient time to test so as to guarantee that the adjustments are effective and reasonable. Therefore, commanders, please bear with us our regular balance adjustments, because these work is intended to provide you with more strategies and tactics, and better game experience.

[h1]The Terran[/h1]

[code]“We have been always keeping a close eye on extra economy left in the final battle due to the population restriction. The Terran may be the race that is affected the most. However, it is still unreasonable that the Asterion deals much higher damage to ground units than to air units.”[/code]

[b]Units[/b]

Defense reduced from 3 to 2, and increased explosive damage after upgrade

Lv2: Inflicts 200% explosive damage to nearby enemy units upon dying
Lv3: Inflicts 400% explosive damage to nearby enemy units upon dying

Active ability only deals 50% damage to buildings

HP increased from 70 to 100, and range increased from 11 to 13

Anti-ground attack speed decreased from 1.2s to 2s

Full Alert

[code]“The Atlac win ratio in Ranked 3V3 & 1V1 involving those high-ranking players is apparently much higher than that of the two other races, this is because of their strong mid game troop composition due to the low Transformation cost. notes.title: Update: Bug Fixes, Improvements and Change of Coin Cap
notes.content:
We will have a server maintenance to deploy bug fixes, improvements and the change of coin cap. The maintenance is expected to last for 2 hours, and starts at:

01:00 PDT June 15
08:00 GMT June 15
16:00 GMT+8 June 15

[b]Change of Coin Cap[/b]
In this update, the coin cap will be removed. Commanders will be able to gain coins without a cap, but the amount will decrease with play time. It is divided into 4 phases:
[list]
    [*]Phase 1 (0-4,000 coins gained in a week): commanders will gain coins at a normal rate
    [*]Phase 2 (4,001-6,000): commanders will gain coins at 50% rate of that of phase 1
    [*]Phase 3 (6,001-8,000): commanders will gain coins at 50% rate of that of phase 2
    [*]Phase 4 (above 8,001): commanders will gain coins at 50% rate of that of phase 3
[/list]

For more details, please click the link below:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/558100/discussions/0/1353742967825150239/] About the change on coin cap and why we had coin cap[/url]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[olist]
    [*]Fixed stutter/lag caused by the tutorial tip of clicking Missile Strike when using Bombing Run.
    [*]Fixed the error notification of “You have reached the weekly cap of coins gained from battles” when weekly cap actually hasn’t been reached in Overview screen after the battle, and removed weekly coin cap boost rewarded by reputation.
    [*]Fixed red dot notification displayed on the upper right of the Inbox even if there is no unread mail.
    [*]Fixed the disappearance of special effects of chest & drop in Store—Supply Drop under 1920*1080 resolution.
    [*]Fixed the bug of terran logo displaying in atlac and yaoguai troops in Army Setup.
    [*]Fixed the bug of team chat contents appearing in the private chat between team members.
    [*]Fixed the bug of a very few players’ being the member of two clans.
[/olist]
	
[b]Improvements[/b]
[olist]
    [*]No FORCED 1V1 Versus A.I. and 3V3 Quick Play any more in Tutorial.
    [*]Differentiated the light colors of Teleport and Swap between two sides in a battle: blue for the left side while red for the right side.
    [*]Unified the gold icon respectively on the upper left and bottom right of the battle screen.
    [*]Corrected the notification contents appeared when clicking Agree/Disagree button after your teammate calls a surrender.
[/olist]	

[b]New Balance[/b]
[olist]
    [*]Adjusted ban rules: terran mobile radar, atlac void fish and yaoguai gazer cannot be banned in ranked game.
    [*]We are always keeping an extremely close eye on unit and skill data concluded from matches, such as banning ratio, K/D, average attack damage, win ration of different levels, etc. We have been also collecting players’ feedback all the time to make the next update better. :)	
[/olist]	
Commanders, thanks for your support. The faster you can offer feedback, the quicker we can respond to various bugs and problems. We will continue to collect your opinions and advice, so again, please don’t hesitate to share them with us below!

See you on the battlefield!
The Art of War: Red Tides Team

Art of War: Red Tides was online again at 8th June. And there will be no wipe of progress any more.

It is a fair multiplayer strategy game that will allow different teams to battle against each other on multiple platforms (e.g. PC, iOS, Android, etc.). And all the players around the world can play the game on the same server.

[b]Since we have confirmed that this time players’ game progress will be saved, we understand that your concern then goes to the following two things:[/b]
[list][*]What had been changed? 
[*]How to get on the Global Leaderboards?
[/list]

[b]Compared with the beta version, this one is different in the following four aspects:[/b]
[list]
[*]Monetization is a must to sustain our service, so we added in-game store. But again, it will sell neither exclusive items that could influence the match, nor in-game coins. That is to say, victory or failure has nothing to do with the purchased items.
[*]We have made tremendous changes on A.I., matchmaking and units/Commander Skills. Generally, units become smarter with more efficient damage output. And you will be matched with opponents of similar level to guarantee your win ratio. Also it would be impossible to achieve victory by only spawning one kind of units. We hope that these changes allow you to play smart.
[*]You can better understand the whole battle even if you are a new comer, as you can easily identify your own troops, remaining units and KD (Kill/Death). These can help you learn how to strengthen units collaboration and overwhelm enemy units.
[*]The dev team upgraded the game server to allow commanders from all over the world to either team up with or fight against each other smoothly. However, if you meet stutters/lags, please tell us in Community or send us emails. We will continue to optimize the game.
[/list]

[b]How to get on the Global Leaderboards? Here are three tips:[/b]
[list]
[*]Create Clan and invite other commanders to join you, so that you won’t fight and level up alone, as the higher the rank, the fiercer the competition will be. Though the functions of the clan system may not meet your need, you can still team up and communicate through it, which may help you get higher rank on the Leaderboards.
[*]Set a small goal, level up on local Leaderboards first, and gradually march toward the elite global rankings. The Leaderboard has also been optimized based on this idea, so you can check your rankings among both local and global players.
[*]Purchase skins. Enemies may get petrified by your dazzling unit skins, and the victory is yours! 
[/list]

[b]Your help is urgently in need:[/b]
[list]
[*]The balance and difficulty of a multiplayer strategy game are vital, so we hope you commanders actively discuss and share your advice and opinions. The more feedback the dev team can collect, the better decision regarding game optimization they can make.
[*]It is impossible to guarantee that no bug and error exist in the game, especially when the version has just been online. So if you meet any problem, such as stutters/lags, errors, something invalid, or even game crash, please report to us on forums or official Facebook page, or send emails to support@gamesci.com.cn. We will try to solve them as soon as possible.
[*]Due to the limited staff and limited English proficiency, the English version is not so English for the English-speaking commanders. We will collect your advice to work out a better English version. If you have better solution, please let us know.
[*]If commanders whose native language is neither Chinese nor English are willing to offer help in localization, please let us know. We hope to forge the most satisfactory localization of the game together with you.
[/list]

No chat any more. Let’s get ready to RUMBLE!

notes.title: Notice: Beta ends on Jan. 25
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/bc8103b5d913a4241937d8471f1b692fbfaabe73.jpg[/img]

Beta will end and server will be offline at:
25/01/2017 09:00 PDT
25/01/2017 11:00 EST
25/01/2017 16:00 GMT
25/01/2017 24:00 GMT+8
The server will then be shut down for few months before the full game released.

By Jan. 18,  more than 350,000 players participated the beta test of Art of War: Red Tides. Frankly, this number is significantly better than what we expected, which is only 20,000 participants.

We have confirmed some uplifting things from this beta test:
[list]
[*]Developing a strategy game having global players in the same server is entirely feasible for us.
[*]Compared with those classic strategy game that inspired us, Art of War: Red Tides is still an quite innovative game, if you have played for 3 hours.
[*]We see a large room for improvement in 3V3 game mode, which is considered as the core game mode of the game. 
[*]Routine scheduled balance adjustment based on detailed data analysis is quite necessary.
[*]Yaoguai with traditional Chinese elements, are well accepted by global players.
[*]Fair game means a lot for every player.
[/list]

We have also noticed some things that we need to be cautious about:
[list]
[*]As a beta game on PC, Art of War: Red Tides looks like a mobile game
[*]Some units are so weak that almost no one used them.
[*]Win ratio will drop dramatically if you don't queue in a premade team.
[*]AI needs much more effort for further improvement.
[*]At one time there are too many AFKers in the game.
[*]...
[/list]

We have read every review on steam store page, every comment on steam forum and every message on Facebook, and we firmly believe that no matther how harsh the criticism is, it is the players' true feelings.

To further improve the game and support more platforms means most developers and designers into game development instead of game operations. Game Science is only a studio with 20+ people, it is quite difficult for us to focus on game development and game operations at the same time. Based on the reasons above, we decided to shut down the server for few months on Jan. 25. Please beware that all the progress will be wiped out after the beta test. 

In order to make all players have no much regret during the beta, after Jan. 20 5:00 a.m. (GMT+8), rewards for the first win of the day will increase to 5,000 coins + 500 gems. You can unlock the units you like and try the strategy you prefer. 

Thanks again for your support and help during the beta. After few months, you will see a complete Art of War: Red Tides with more units, commander skills, better balance, smarter AI and better compatibility and stability.

Dear commander, we hope you have nice days during this break, and we will move forward with the trust of 350,000 commanders.


The Art of War: Red Tides Team
