notes.title: 05/01 Update: New Balance, Bug Fixes and new mode Desert Storm!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229190/708d7087f41285051abf062664052646c25b2e90.jpg[/img]
We will have a server maintenance to deploy new balance, bug fixes and new game mode Desert Storm. The maintenance is expected to last for 2 hours, and starts at:

01:00 PDT
03:00 EST
08:00 GMT
16:00 GMT+8

[h1]DESERT STORM[/h1]
Desert Storm is the first released featured game mode. Commanders above level 8 can click the new star named Arena to play.

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the units counting problem in final battle.
[*]Fixed the achivements display problem.
[*]Fixed the bug that the beetles do not explode when mind controlled.
[*]Fixed the bug that the Great Vajra does not attack the enemy base when stand by it.
[/list]

[h1]IMPROVEMENT[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can adjust the volume in Options now.
[*]Rules of the positions in team in ranked mode changed: solo queue player will have a random position, the positions for flex queue players are the same as  the positions in the premade team.
[*]Tips for weekly coins gain cap added when battle ends
[*]AI of Azure Dragon improved so that it will now try to attack the enemies in the distance.
[*]The ability of Blademaster will be activated immediately when unleashed.
[/list]

[h1]NEW BALANCE: TERRAN[/H1]
[b]Interceptor[/b]
[list]
[*]Hit Speed to 1.4sec (from 2.0sec)
[*]Upgrade increases more damage
[/list]
[b]Marauder[/b]
[list]
[*]Upgrade increases more HP
[/list]
[b]Vanguard[/b]
[list]
[*]Can attack maximum 2 enemies at the same time (increased from 1)
[/list]
[b]Gorilla[/b]
[list]
[*]Attack Range increased to 11 from 9
[*]Upgrade increases damage instead of HP
[/list]
[b]Multirole Tank[/b]
[list]
[*]Attack Range increased to 26 from 20
[*]Armor decreased to 4 from 6
[/list]
[b]Heavy Tank[/b]
[list]
[*]Damage increased to 20 from 16 when in Bunker mode
[/list]
[b]Ancile[/b]
[list]
[*]Attack range of active ability increased to 30 from 20
[*]Upgrade increases damage instead of HP
[/list]
[b]Battleship[/b]
[list]
[*]Armor increased to 100 from 20 when ability in activation
[/list]
[h1]NEW BALANCE: ATLAC[/H1]
[b]Scholar[/b]
[list]
[*]Production Cost decreased to 300 from 400
[/list]
[b]Templar[/b]
[list]
[*]Area Damage will not be reduced with range
[/list]
[b]Arhat[/b]
[list]
[*]Active Ability increases 50% damage (reduced from 100%)
[*]Damage to ground units decreased to 35 from 47. Damge to air units remains the same (47).
[*]Armor decreased to 5 from 7
[/list]
[b]Skycrab[/b]
[list]
[*]Hit Speed to 3.30sec (from 4.00sec)
[/list]
[b]Blind Skycrab[/b]
[list]
[*]When ability in activation, attack range increased to 45 from 35, damage increased to 80

[/list]

[list]
[*]Attack range decreased to 30 from 35
[/list]
[b]White Shark[/b]
[list]
[*]Attack range increased to 26 from 22
[/list]
[b]Great Whale[/b]
[list]
[*]HP increased to 150 from 100
[/list]
[b]Savage Whale[/b]
[list]
[*]Attack range increased to 26 from 24
[*]Damage increased to 55 from 30
[/list]
[h1]NEW BALANCE: YAOGUAI[/H1]
[b]Eagle[/b]
[list]
[*]HP decreased to 65 from 80
[/list]
[b]Blood Eagle[/b]
[list]
[*]Armor increased to 5 from 3
[/list]
[b]Deer[/b]
[list]
[*]Healing can restore 35 HP (increased from 20)
[/list]
[b]Immortal Deer[/b]
[list]
[*]Damage increased to 20 from 13
[/list]
[b]Amethyst Spider[/b]
[list]
[*]HP decreased to 90 from 120
[*]The number of maximum enemies attack at the same time decreased

[list]

[list]

[list]
[*]Damage decreased to 25 from 30

[list]

[list]
[*]Changed to mechanical

[list]
[*]Changed to mechanical

notes.title: 29/12 Update: New Balance, Bug Fixes and 1V1 Available Now!
notes.content:
[img] https://scontent.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t31.0-8/15732689_1696894487288308_4879098397237547803_o.jpg?oh=e07555ea8beaa624a82c236729dc1091&oe=58E11C72[/img]

We will have a server maintenance to deploy new balance, bug fixes and new 1V1 mode. The maintenance is expected to last for [b]2 hours[/b], and starts at:

01:00 PDT
03:00 EST
08:00 GMT
16:00 GMT+8


[h1]1V1 NOW AVAILABLE[/h1]
[list]
[*]1V1 is now available in Quick Play and Ranked Mode.
[*]You no longer need to remind your allies to upgrade mine and product detectors, and watch [*]them using strange tactics and absolutely destroyed by their lane opponents. 
[*]The 1V1 mode is just in beta, it might be possible that we disable this mode temporarily when having critical problems.
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Frost Arhat now can attack normally.
[*]Fixed the bug that some units can still attack after being petrified.
[*]The attack range of White Shark is now 22, the same as in description.
[*]Sand Basilisk now can move together with other units after setting out from the base.
[*]Fixed the bug of removing friends.
[*]When you lose in Ranked mode, you won’t occasionally lose 2 stars now.
[*]Fixed the bug that some units might get stuck at some locations.
[*]Fixed the bug that some units might attack the Great Piranha that already burrowed into the ground.
[*]Improved the network performance during the battle.
[/list]

[h1]NEW BALANCE[/h1]
We do accept Spam, but we do not accept that spam is becoming the only and best tactics in early game. Besides, we have noticed the tactics of spamming a single unit will cause congested battlefield. Any balance problem can hardly be solved in just one adjustment, we will maintain attention.

[b]Illusionist[/b]
[list]
[*]The attack range of Illusionist decreased from 18 to 15.
[*]The maximum energy of Illusionist will not increased after being upgraded
[*]Lv0 Illusionist can summon a phantom of Blade Slave with 1 damage, 1 armor, 1 shield and 1 HP.
[*]Lv1 Illusionist can summon a phantom of Blade Slave with the ability of Charge.
[*]Lv2 Illusionist’s damage increased to 10.
[*]Lv3 Illusionist can summon 2 phantoms of Blade Slave at a time.
[/list]

[b]Grenade Launcher[/b]
[list]
[*]The damage bonus from Stimulant decreased from 5 to 2.
[/list]

[b]Turret[/b]
[list]
[*]The armor of mid-turret increased from 4 to 6.
[*]The armor of inner-turret increased from 4 to 8.
[/list]

[b]Commander Skill: Great Piranha[/b]
[list]
[*]The damage of Great Piranha when swimming underground decreased from 100 to 70.
[/list]

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*]The weekly cap for coins increased to 10,000.
[*]Leaderboards now support scrolling up or down.
[*]If a player can reconnect in 5 minutes (increased from 3 minutes) after disconnected, will not be regarded as leave.
[*]Typing in battle will not trigger hotkeys anymore.
[*]Decreased the latency when click the mine to upgrade.
[*]Improved the user experience of tutorial.
[*]Commanders from the losing side now can also win the MVP.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the update! Please let us know what you think. 

See you on the battlefield,
The Art of War: Red Tides Team

notes.title: Open Beta FAQ
notes.content:
[h1]When will the Beta end?[/h1]
Before we release the beta, we did not imagine that we could attract many beta paticipants in a short period, so we said "up to 2 months". We will discuss this issue in few days and try to figure our a better schedule for beta. Once the end date determined, we will let you know.

[h1]Do you plan on wiping progress during Beta in the future?[/h1]
Yes, after beta is done we will do complete wipe for all accounts. But all players participated in beta will get nice exclusive gfits after official release. 
[list]
[*]Players over Level 30 will get an exclusive commander icon
[*]Players over level 50 will get an exclusive unit skin of Marauder
[/list]
For more information please refer to this [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/558100/announcements/detail/549835216478272749]announcement.[/url]

[h1]When is the offcial release?[/h1]
Not decided yet, and we will not offcially release the game soon after the beta ends. If you have tried our game, you could findout that we just have the core aspects of the game implemented. Features like new units and commander skills, better leaverbuster, better communication for players from different countries, more game modes... need to be done, and that needs time. But we will keep you update about our progress for sure!

[h1]What languages the Open Beta supports?[/h1]
Art of War: Red Tides Open Beta supports Simplified Chinese and English, and the English translation is incomplete with many mistakes, as we did the translation by ourselves. Hope that will not disturb you a lot. We will try to improve it in next patches and we welcome any suggestion! Besides, we will try to support more languages in official release!

[h1]Will Art of War: Red Tides be a pay to win game?[/h1]
We won't. As game developers we do not like those p2w games, and we won't do things that we hate. The Coins can purchase everything that can influence the battle, like units and runes. But coins can be gained only through battles, no other channels. Our planned monetization model is based on a third currency (unavailable in beta), which can be purchased with real money. It can be used to buy units skins, alternate skill effects and items for convinience like rune page. These items won't influence the battle completely. Besides, we also think boost items is not a bad idea, as not everyone has much time in playing games. In the end, I think if you had played the game you might found that even you have more units and runes, it still might be possible that you will lose to someone with default units and runes. Observe, Analyze, Action, Cooperation and then the Victory ---- This is the fun of game! Isn't it?
